subject: This is what happens when we work together

body:
\-- |
#
---
Team, In Michigan, we don’t just _talk_ about delivering results for working families. **We’re actually doing it.** I stood before the Mackinac Policy Conference today to announce that we’re making _significant progress_ in our work to expand affordable housing, lower energy costs, and create a future where _every_ Michigan family has the opportunity to thrive. **[I’ll explain more in a second, but before I do, will you consider chipping in a donation to Fight Like Hell PAC to help me continue delivering results for working families?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85883752/476182410/1253923687?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240529_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWRiYjg4MjItMWQxZS1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=iXYE85zQLZKeB8pi1C1U9o13sbsM_A6Q4hdlHBfrRTQ=)** | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85883753/476182411/1253923687?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240529_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWRiYjg4MjItMWQxZS1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=iXYE85zQLZKeB8pi1C1U9o13sbsM_A6Q4hdlHBfrRTQ=)
---
In September 2021, I set an ambitious goal of building or rehabilitating **75,000 housing units** by September 2026 to expand affordable housing and lower housing prices for working families.
**We’re on track to reach that goal more than a year in advance.** That’s why I’m increasing our goal to **115,000 housing units** to make _even more_ progress in our work to ensure every Michigander can afford to have a place to call home.
But that’s not all. Thanks to the Biden-Harris administration, we’re receiving federal resources that will help us lower energy costs for **28,000 working families.**

Hey Peter, as we wrap up AANHPI Month, I wanted to share a personal story with you.

During World War II, 20,000 Japanese Americans were rounded up and forced into internment camps -- by their own government.

**My family was among those wrongly incarcerated in 1942.** _My grandparents and my parents were all sent to Japanese American internment camps during World War II because of racist, fear-mongering policies._ They lost everything and had no choice but to rebuild their entire lives after the war.

The consequences of this internment were far-reaching and still felt by generations today:
* Japanese-American families collectively **lost $400 million** in property
* Many families **stopped speaking Japanese** and weren't able to pass the language down to their children
* Japanese **traditions and cultures were stigmatized and banned** including sports like sumo and religions.

**Our histories in this country have always been fraught. Even today, we 're seeing a rise in AAPI hate spurred by the COVID-19 pandemic. **

It's why I have championed legislation in Congress to prohibit imprisonment of Americans based on protected classes like race and ethnicity. It's why I've fought back against far-right hate toward minority communities. **It 's why I keep fighting everyday.**

[**Peter, today I 'm asking you to join my continued fight for progress and equality for ALL Americans - regardless of race, sexuality, gender, and more. Friend, I have taken some time in the aftermath of the election to be with my family, and tonight I wanted to make sure to reach out to you, and say thank you so much to everyone who supported my campaign in every way.

My husband Justin was my rock through this campaign and our 18 years together, and our children are the light of my life. I also extend thanks to all of my supporters, in every corner of House District 08. Thank you for opening your doors to me, from the Whiteaker to Fox Hollow, from Friendly to Campus to Laurel Hill, and telling me what you want from your next Member of the Oregon House. I am grateful to all the Eugene Democrats who voted for me to represent you, and I am especially appreciative for nearly 400 donations, averaging about $200; our dozens of volunteers; and everyone in the community who made this grassroots campaign possible. I particularly want to thank my boss, our next Senator from Portland, Rep. Khanh Pham, who insisted I run this race from the very first moment, and is an inspiration and true luminary for Oregon’s progressive future. I also thank all of the legislators, local leaders, our state’s Labor Commissioner, and organizations and unions who backed me in this race: The American Federation of Teachers (AFT) Oregon, The Oregon Working Families Party, UFCW Local 555, SEIU, the Sierra Club of Oregon, Lead Locally, Progressive Democrats of America, Single Payer Advocates of Oregon, Next Up Action Fund, and others.
Together, our crew dedicated volunteers knocked on almost 7,000 doors. I knocked on 1,495 myself, each one with a hand written note from me. As a community organizer, it was a joy. We were up against $130,000 in negative campaigning from developer Brian Clem. Although the result was not as we had hoped for, there is still more work to be done to create the change our community needs. I have called my opponent and offered my congratulations. In these moments I return to the words of Václav Havel, who said: “Hope is not the conviction that something will turn out well, but the certainty that something is worth doing no matter how it turns out.” The work does not end here and I will always stand up for our beloved Eugene, and our climate future. Thank you.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: please don’t forget about this
body:
Don’t write this state off just yet...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

_USA Today_ recently published an article gloating:

_“In states with abortion restrictions, 8,000 people each month get abortion pills elsewhere.”_

As we’ve been telling legislators ever since the fall of _Roe,_ it’s not enough to pass Abortion Prevention Laws.

If we really want to save lives, we have to stop abortion pill trafficking.

One of the states we’ve been hard at work in is Oklahoma.

You see, while Oklahoma’s current Abortion Prevention Law protects Life in nearly all cases, trafficking of Chemical Abortion Pills into the Sooner State hasn’t let up.

The good news is, the Oklahoma State Legislature recently voted on the _Abortion Pill Trafficking Act_ (H.B. 3013), and we have everyone on the record.

The bad news is weak-kneed Republicans _\- namely State Senate Majority Leader Greg McCortney and his cohorts -_ voted against the bill, allowing the abortion industry to continue trafficking pills into the state.

**_They have officially caved to the Abortion Lobby._**

Now they’ll have to answer to all their angry voters during the June primaries after we send our student activists to their districts to knock on doors and tell their voters the TRUTH.

All I need is your help to pull it off, Pro-Life Friend.

**[Would you please consider helping our efforts by making your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ to support our student canvasser deployments](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gxput-duchtdja-y/)? **

As you can see Pro-Life Friend, even in Oklahoma, a state dominated by Republicans that many consider to be pro-life, that isn’t enough.

This just proves that you and I can’t afford to view “red” states as guaranteed victories in 2024.

_We have to fight . . ._

That’s why, with so much on the line in 2024, _Students for Life Action_ is going further than ever before by deploying our student canvassers to key battleground states across the country.

Oklahoma is one of those states. But, it’s not all.

Our students have been doing incredible work blazing a trail of grassroots pro-life support and holding squishy Republicans accountable by educating voters on how “faux-life” their elected officials really are.

In fact, we’ve already seen tremendous impact from our deployments in other states, including:

**•** West Virginia
**•** South Carolina
**•** Iowa
**•** Florida
**•** Virginia
**•** Arizona
**And it just so happens that our next deployment is in Oklahoma this Saturday, June 1st!**

But to make sure our canvasser deployment to the Sooner State has the effect we need, I’ll need to rely on the generous support of good folks like you, Pro-Life Friend.

**[So, would you please consider making your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or $25 to _Students for Life Action_ right away so I can make sure our canvassers have everything they need when they’re deployed to Oklahoma](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gxput-duchtdja-j/)?**

As the 2024 elections get closer and closer, our actions leading up to them become more and more crucial.

Meaning that if we don’t hold turncoat Republicans accountable now, then even more of them will come out of the woodworks before election day.

**[Please help us hold the line](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gxput-duchtdja-i/).**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Advancing progressive power at the ballot box & in the streets / Impulsando el poder progresista en las urnas y en las calles
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Progressive forces strike back in Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Lauren%20Ashley%20Simmons.jpg]
Tuesday's election results in the Texas Democratic Primary Runoff make clear once more that progressive values, policies, and leaders are the future of Texas. TOP is building this future each election cycle through year-round, issue-based organizing rooted in economic and racial justice that links what matters in the daily lives of Black and Latino Texans to the ballot box.
Our members are proud to have endorsed Rebeca Clay-Flores [https://rebecaclayflores.com/] (Bexar County Commissioner, Pct. 1), Lauren Ashley Simmons [https://www.laurenashleysimmons.com/] (Texas State Representative, Dist. 146), Molly Cook [https://www.mollyfortexas.com/] (Texas Senate, Dist. 15), as well as Annette Ramirez [https://www.electannetteramirez.com/] (Harris County Tax Assessor-Collector), and we congratulate them on their runoff wins Tuesday. In Harris County, two progressive community champions, Molly Cook and Lauren Ashley Simmons, were victorious against well-funded, conservative Dem. incumbents.
This is what happens when a people-powered progressive agenda is coupled with vigorous on-the-ground voter engagement.
This vision is needed now more than ever as we counter unprecedented right-wing attacks on our basic rights, while paving the road to the future where ALL Texans are represented fairly – regardless of our race, age, faith, gender, or economic status. The general election is fast approaching, and TOP PAC is fully prepared to utilize this progressive momentum to meaningfully connect with voters at their doorstep and further transform the political terrain of Texas.
Fighting for the storm recovery ALL Houstonians deserve
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%202024%20storm%20canvass.jpg]
HARRIS COUNTY RESIDENTS! You deserve a power grid that won’t fail in the next storm. The devastating impact of these recent Houston storms highlights the urgent need for comprehensive climate action and infrastructure reform. Climate change is not a distant threat; it’s here and now, and it’s hitting our working Black and Latino communities the hardest.
Join our Houston Community Resource Relief Townhall with allies on June 8th at Pleasant Hill Baptist Church from 12 - 3 p.m. as we come together after the storm to discuss community-driven solutions to climate change, and to make sure we can protect our families and neighbors before the next devastating storm hits.
RSVP for the Houston Community Resource Relief Townhall here. [https://secure.everyaction.com/CEmyE6ENTkuECpsESmhuZw2]
For more information, email Sofia Lopez at slopez@organizetexas.org [slopez@organizetexas.org] .
Apply to join Team Teal
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/We%20are%20hiring%20-%20English.png]
If you or someone you know cares deeply about social justice and transforming our state so Black and Latino Texans have the political power they deserve, then check out TOP’s current job openings [https://organizetexas.org/about-top/employment/] . Don't hesitate to connect us to any talented and passionate community members you may have in mind.
Feel free to email recruit@organizetexas.org [recruit@organizetexas.org] with any questions or to apply.
TOP Tips: Turn on severe weather alerts on your smartphone
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/GenericiPhone-ezgif.com-webp-to-jpg-converter.jpeg]
Climate change is REAL , and Texas weather can change on a dime. That's why it's as important as ever that you keep weather alerts active on your smartphone. Make sure you receive those alerts on your iPhone or Android here. [https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/2024/02/28/iphone-android-weather-alerts/72770523007/]
Español
Fuerzas progresistas contraatacan en Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Lauren%20Ashley%20Simmons.jpg]
Los resultados de las elecciones del martes en la segunda vuelta de las primarias demócratas de Texas dejan claro una vez más que los valores, las políticas y los líderes progresistas son el futuro de Texas. TOP está construyendo este futuro en cada ciclo electoral a través de una organización basada en temas a lo largo de todo el año y basada en la justicia económica y racial que vincula lo que importa en la vida diaria de los Tejanos Negros y Latinos con las urnas.
Nuestros miembros están orgullosos de haber respaldado a Rebeca Clay-Flores [https://rebecaclayflores.com/] (Comisionada del Condado de Bexar, Pct. 1), Lauren Ashley Simmons [https://www.laurenashleysimmons.com/] (Representante del Estado de Texas, Dist. 146), Molly Cook [https://www.mollyfortexas.com/] (Senado de Texas, Dist. 15), así como a Annette Ramirez [https://www.electannetteramirez.com/] (Tasadora-Recaudadora de Impuestos del Condado de Harris), y nosotros Felicitarlos por sus victorias en la segunda vuelta del martes. En el condado de Harris, dos campeonas comunitarias progresistas, Molly Cook y Lauren Ashley Simmons, obtuvieron la victoria contra demócratas bien financiados.
Esto es lo que sucede cuando una agenda progresista impulsada por el pueblo se combina con una vigorosa participación de los votantes sobre el terreno.
Esta visión es necesaria ahora más que nunca mientras contrarrestamos los ataques derechistas sin precedentes a nuestros derechos básicos, al tiempo que allanamos el camino hacia un futuro en el que TODOS los tejanos estén representados de manera justa, independientemente de nuestra raza, edad, fe, género o situación económica. Las elecciones generales se acercan rápidamente y TOP PAC está completamente preparado para utilizar este impulso progresista para conectarse significativamente con los votantes a sus puertas y transformar aún más el terreno político de Texas.
Luchando por la recuperación de la tormenta que TODOS los habitantes de Houston merecen
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%202024%20storm%20canvass.jpg]
¡RESIDENTES DEL CONDADO DE HARRIS! Usted merece una red eléctrica que no fallará en la próxima tormenta. El impacto devastador de estas recientes tormentas en Houston resalta la urgente necesidad de una acción climática integral y una reforma de la infraestructura. El cambio climático no es una amenaza lejana; está aquí y ahora, y está afectando más duramente a nuestras comunidades trabajadoras Negras y Latinas.
Únase a nuestra reunión pública de ayuda de recursos comunitarios de Houston con aliados el 8 de junio en la Iglesia Bautista Pleasant Hill de 12 a 3 p.m. mientras nos reunimos después de la tormenta para discutir soluciones al cambio climático impulsadas por la comunidad y para asegurarnos de que podamos proteger a nuestras familias y vecinos antes de que llegue la próxima tormenta devastadora.
Confirme su asistencia al Ayuntamiento de Ayuda a los Recursos Comunitarios de Houston aquí. [https://secure.everyaction.com/CEmyE6ENTkuECpsESmhuZw2]
Para obtener más información, envíe un correo electrónico a Sofia Lopez a slopez@organizetexas.org [slopez@organizetexas.org] .
Solicite unirse al Team Teal
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Spanish%20-%20we%20are%20hiring.png]
Si usted o alguien que conoce se preocupa profundamente por la justicia social y por transformar nuestro estado para que los Tejanos Negros y Latinos tengan el poder político que merecen, consulte las vacantes laborales actuales de TOP [https://organizetexas.org/about-top/employment/] . No dude en conectarnos con cualquier miembro talentoso y apasionado de la comunidad que pueda tener en mente.
No dude en enviar un correo electrónico a recruit@organizetexas.org [recruit@organizetexas.org] si tiene alguna pregunta o para postularse.
Consejos de TOP: Activa alertas de clima severo en tu smartphone
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/GenericiPhone-ezgif.com-webp-to-jpg-converter.jpeg]
El cambio climático es REAL y el clima de Texas puede cambiar en un abrir y cerrar de ojos. Por eso es tan importante como siempre que mantengas activas las alertas meteorológicas en tu smartphone. Asegúrese de recibir esas alertas en su iPhone o Android aquí. [https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/2024/02/28/iphone-android-weather-alerts/72770523007/]

Our members are proud to have endorsed Rebeca Clay-Flores [] (Bexar County Commissioner, Pct. 1), Lauren Ashley Simmons [] (Texas State Representative, Dist. 146), Molly Cook [] (Texas Senate, Dist. 15), as well as Annette Ramirez [] (Harris County Tax Assessor-Collector), and we congratulate them on their runoff wins Tuesday. In Harris County, two progressive community champions, Molly Cook and Lauren Ashley Simmons, were victorious against well-funded, conservative Dem. incumbents. This is what happens when a people-powered progressive agenda is coupled with vigorous on-the-ground voter engagement. This vision is needed now more than ever as we counter unprecedented right-wing attacks on our basic rights, while paving the road to the future where ALL Texans are represented fairly – regardless of our race, age, faith, gender, or economic status. The general election is fast approaching, and TOP PAC is fully prepared to utilize this progressive momentum to meaningfully connect with voters at their doorstep and further transform the political terrain of Texas. Fighting for the storm recovery ALL Houstonians deserve [] HARRIS COUNTY RESIDENTS! You deserve a power grid that won’t fail in the next storm. The devastating impact of these recent Houston storms highlights the urgent need for comprehensive climate action and infrastructure reform. Climate change is not a distant threat; it’s here and now, and it’s hitting our working Black and Latino communities the hardest. Join our Houston Community Resource Relief Townhall with allies on June 8th at Pleasant Hill Baptist Church from 12 - 3 p.m. as we come together after the storm to discuss community-driven solutions to climate change, and to make sure we can protect our families and neighbors before the next devastating storm hits. RSVP for the Houston Community Resource Relief Townhall here. [] For more information, email Sofia Lopez at slopez@organizetexas.org [slopez@organizetexas.org] . Apply to join Team Teal [] If you or someone you know cares deeply about social justice and transforming our state so Black and Latino Texans have the political power they deserve, then check out TOP’s current job openings [] . Don't hesitate to connect us to any talented and passionate community members you may have in mind. Feel free to email recruit@organizetexas.org [recruit@organizetexas.org] with any questions or to apply. name: Tim Ballard
subject: I can't forget their faces
body:
I have helped rescue thousands of children and women from sex traffickers. My story was told in the film “Sound of Freedom.” But now, I am being PERSECUTED for fighting the good fight and I need your help.

| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpal7d8dh20a5pggdod5vnbc4pqa80o0v0ogf008_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c1hmao36cdh2bs)
---
I see the victims’ faces every time I close my eyes. _“Why, Heavenly Father?”_ I ask God each night. **[I have helped rescue thousands of children and women from sex traffickers. My story was told in the film “Sound of Freedom” and I later went on to serve on President Trump’s human trafficking advisory board.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpkq47hgjnggq57gttrm81uad35a1r93e1mji7h8_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c1hmao36cdh2bs)** It is hard to describe the full picture on the silver screen or even tell the President of the United States in a humane way. What I have witnessed will scar you for life. subject: Free eBook from Victor Davis Hanson: Dueling Populisms
body:
Populism is nothing new to world history.

Dear Friend, Populism is nothing new to world history. While it can be easy to think about American politics as being divided between the Left and the Right, the reality is much different.
| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zmekfhuu5p1d6nakh2n96vhhohjrutcf6g5ras9g_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c1hmepr0c3h2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, Populism is nothing new to world history. While it can be easy to think about American politics as being divided between the Left and the Right, the reality is much different. What we've really been seeing is two sets of populist backlash against both the Democrat and Republican establishment.
---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zv1l0nd9qrsdc9kv34ecqdrbarenkc3ho8ldk1go_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c1hmepr0c3h2bs)
---
| | And believe it or not, these tensions actually trace their roots back to Roman times.

That's why I'm sending you this email today.

I want to make sure you get a free copy of one of our popular eBooks: **[Dueling Populisms by Victor Davis Hanson](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zdg4serli4e80sbo2t5pncmssbj4gfp7gd5qohfg_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c1hmepr0c3h2bs)**.

Hanson is a Hoover Senior Fellow and world-renowned historian, and I think you'll get a lot out of his insights. Inside this important eBook, you'll learn more about:
* What we can expect from a political climate ruled by movements that rebel against both the establishment--and each other.
* The important parallels between these ancient movements and their modern counterparts in both progressive and conservative populism.
* What lies ahead for America as we revive these ancient tensions in our culture.

You can get your free copy of Dueling Populisms using this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/dueling-populisms-signup/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zt6stv56iddinubrq0u25ghcll3qt46bag96ni5g_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c1hmepr0c3h2bs)**.

And please feel free to share this with your family and friends. It's important that we recall the voices of experience and apply them to contemporary conflicts and challenges.

You can use this link to get access to your free eBook right now.
Thanks, Greg Greg Stamps | Online Development Hoover Institution | Stanford University
---

body:
I have helped rescue thousands of children and women from sex traffickers. My story was told in the film “Sound of Freedom.” But now, I am being PERSECUTED for fighting the good fight and I need your help.

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8as616e8qcg17pf09jemg94f3c6sq8aafarruag_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c1hm1or2cjh2bs)
---
I see the victims’ faces every time I close my eyes. _“Why, Heavenly Father?”_ I ask God each night. **[I have helped rescue thousands of children and women from sex traffickers. My story was told in the film “Sound of Freedom” and I later went on to serve on President Trump’s human trafficking advisory board.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zi159n2opkhdqerad21cs0fbt49h0hl0renlgfd0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c1hm1or2cjh2bs)** It is hard to describe the full picture on the silver screen or even tell the President of the United States in a humane way. What I have witnessed will scar you for life. Going into the lion’s den time and time again as an undercover operator is by far the hardest thing I have ever done. **[**But now, I am being PERSECUTED for fighting the good fight and I need your help.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z56tb662s7jk05604fsniud4o32usbi22ht0dtog_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c1hm1or2cjh2bs)**

---
This persecution is already taking a toll. Operations to rescue women and children on three different continents have been destroyed. We can’t let this go on any longer. It’s time to take a stand and finally direct resources toward their highest value. Though I am persecuted, I know I am not alone. God is with me. The truth is with me. _**[**I hope you are with me, too.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zib9oa0cvl3u4d2tk29th29e4ba3ctslcbktc5p0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c1hm1or2cjh2bs)**_

## Alito Rejects Calls to Recuse Himself
Supreme Court Justice Samuel Alito told lawmakers Wednesday that he [wouldn't recuse himself](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LuOwyAQheGnwR3WMB4gKSi2cZdtt7QIl2QibCybxMrbr7L1dqc40if9P5fp4rnwcvv2c3It18mHxq80aTmARJqoiy6nhGnoklNWWbCIGrq7M1FDgARZRX8li8NZU74CWYpWU9YdOwQk0APASRs0PSllPalz0Kccrh4FQYrc6tY_Ki_tnnJ511fa-lDnrrh7a-suhi-Bo8DxOI5-rYUbh_o5CByXdOwCx48icAT92WeBoy_cqszF33bZtue8yodfnn57SyMBlAEi020urgeXwruxguA2ey5_cPs_w8vhbwAAAP__qfJcMA) from cases involving the 2020 election after it was reported that an upside-down flag was flown at his house. The inverted flag, and another colonial-era flag flown at Alito's house, have been associated with former President Donald Trump's assertions that the 2020 election was stolen, and Democrats are urging Alito to recuse himself from those cases. Alito said the flags were flown by his wife and [he wasn't aware of it](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu6yAUgOGngY0IjsGGgeEu3nLXjhaGQ6DCJgKSKG9fpXPnX_qG_-u6XV0u-bz9dwfaEevm_MhP3BSbOAO5SRpsRAScKFqxiIUvAIrTZOM0BcEdxH0OfjbGC6NxDw6MWnatJc0WOEiuJs61mmG-SCEWJ4XxSke_OyCSY8ijtst3zedIGMu7PrFdfD1osWmMeyfTPwIrgXUkTLmUTyOwpnrgia9OYJWzAa40cyWPyhr6R3eFxeJunfl6jvYh-5v1x73hgczXRxsEVtpsuL9yKbnPC5H8drj8y9Px94inhZ8AAAD__-I0YPo) at first. When he asked her to take it down, she refused for several days. "_I had nothing whatsoever to do with the flying of that flag_ ," he said in rejecting calls for his recusal.

| | | | | Peter, I have served this country my entire life. Now that I’ve retired from the US Army as a Brigadier General, I’m ready to continue my service in a new arena. I live in the Georgia district currently represented by Marjorie Taylor Greene. I think my neighbors deserve better. Over the course of 40 years in the armed forces, I served our country in various capacities, including as an infantry commander in Afghanistan following the tragic events of 9/11. I ultimately worked as a senior military advisor at military posts around the world. That means I was providing strategic guidance and leadership to keep our nation strong against foreign adversaries. I took an oath to protect the US Constitution from all enemies, foreign AND domestic. When I left the Army to start my farm here in North Georgia, I discovered that my country still needed me. The current US Congress is the weakest, most chaotic legislature in my memory, and my district is right at the heart of it. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T63605547-6f33-4a3e-815d-f5d933301ccd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) I think Georgia deserves better than Marjorie Taylor Greene. I think America deserves better than Marjorie Taylor Greene. My background on both the enlisted and officer side of the armed forces has prepared me to address the complex challenges facing our nation today. That starts with core American values we are severely lacking from some of our elected officials today.

| | | Members of the Trump jury in his NY trial have begun their deliberations to decide whether he is guilty or not. **And we need to demand they have adequate protection to ensure they can do this right, without putting themselves in danger.[Please join with us in demanding this NOW.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tff30bc8a-8ff8-4350-96ea-1deb9e20e36e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Jury members are already getting veiled (and not so veiled) threats from MAGA extremists and even Trump himself. Jury pool members were dismissed earlier because they felt the danger would impact their ability to render a fair verdict. They'd seen what Trump followers did at the Capitol, and many other places across America. **These jury members need protection -- not just for the duration of the trial, but for an extended period thereafter** , when the threat will still be very real. If they are going to put themselves on the line, we need to be there for them. name: Sheldon Whitehouse
subject: Let’s give Americans the fair shake they deserve:
body:
It’s been clear for a long time that the Supreme Court has a corruption problem
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Teb43a611-8079-4610-8318-3be6b2d9862e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._
---
|
---
| | | Peter, I’m running for re-election in Rhode Island for the United States Senate. [I’m hoping you’ll split a $10 donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbf0db2da-0b82-4804-828f-42a4e100434a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – and here’s why. It’s been clear for a long time that the Supreme Court has a corruption problem. I recently published a law review article highlighting how this captured Supreme Court often simply makes up false facts to arrive at decisions that ultimately benefit partisan Republican special interests. Take Citizens United v. FEC as an example. Remember when the Federalist Society justices said that all the unlimited political spending they were unleashing would be “transparent”? Well, we’ve seen dark money in politics prove them wrong several billion times over. Our system is designed to leave fact-finding to the lower courts that hear testimony, make credibility determinations, and review evidence. The Supreme Court is then supposed to defer to – and not alter – factual records in its decisions. Think about it: if the Highest Court in the Land makes up phony facts, there is nowhere else the parties can appeal to. The captured Roberts Court has done a lot of this phony fact-finding in big decisions that have fundamentally changed life in America. The Dobbs decision that ended a fundamental freedom for women is another one that was built on made-up history. How are the American people supposed to trust a Court that makes up its own rules to concoct decisions that suit right-wing special interests? [I won’t give up my fight to improve transparency and accountability at the Supreme Court, but I need your help. Split a contribution today to send me back to the Senate so I can protect American democracy and make sure our Court is giving Americans the fair shake they deserve.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te5550671-6014-4ac8-9021-15b0a9b1c405/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| Americans deserve a Court that plays by the rules. \- Sheldon Whitehouse

You may have noticed the right wing assault on all things diversity related. Whether its their attacks on Critical Race Theory (CRT), Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI), or Affirmative Action (AA)--conservatives have waged an all out culture war on anything that makes them uncomfortable.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5c304880-92bc-43e1-8980-5c9bdbff9bdb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
More than 35 states have attempted to ban, or [successfully banned CRT](https://substack.com/redirect/f3cb550b-1a04-4a4f-a7f7-4491aa390f02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). More than 30 states are trying to [do the same with DEI](https://substack.com/redirect/bf94b512-18ca-459a-9a25-3de0869b5dec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). I'll address these more directly in future articles. Today, I want to provide a handy three step guide to explain Affirmative Action to conservatives, especially given that the our right wing [Supreme Court has repealed Affirmative Action](https://substack.com/redirect/c73429dd-1724-4c3c-a268-f58488fa3096?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) altogether.
**Related:[The Supreme Court has been the greatest obstacle to justice in America](https://open.substack.com/pub/qasimrashid/p/what-if-the-greatest-obstacle-to?r=fyvxf&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web)**
**First, explain the history of who Affirmative Action benefitted** _**most**_**-- because it was not Black people.** In reality, the demographic that benefitted most from Affirmative Action--more than Black, Indigenous, Latino, and Asian Americans _combined_ --are white women. As TIME Magazine [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/da504407-9325-4e08-a81a-2497db2364c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> While people of color, individually and as groups, have been helped by affirmative action in the subsequent years, data and studies suggest women -- white women in particular -- [have benefited disproportionately](https://substack.com/redirect/f31d43fb-2aa6-4771-b3c6-aff29173f449?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). According to [one study](https://substack.com/redirect/dc0f2349-0d4c-4964-bb42-481c86ce0b72?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), in 1995, 6 million women, the majority of whom were white, had jobs they wouldn't have otherwise held but for affirmative action. Another [study](https://substack.com/redirect/8f5b0ac2-a384-433f-9a26-63702729931a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) shows that women made [more than 7X] greater gains in employment at companies that do business with the federal government, which are therefore subject to federal affirmative-action requirements. Even in the private sector, the advancements of white women eclipse those of people of color.
> | [](https://substack.com/redirect/b583680f-a5b5-436a-a2e1-e2a41eca68b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
> ---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..sOLH50YAL1fev6LKUBvw3vrP0WqRmFc7hKcTZhHpJQU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144793664)
**Next, explain that Affirmative Action was** _**never**_**about accepting unqualified people (whether they were women or of color, or women of color).** Affirmative Action was _always_ about ensuring underrepresented qualified people _also_ had a fair shot at acceptance. Universities and corporations systemically discriminated against non-white applicants for the entirety of American history up through Jim Crow.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ded3fa04-068a-4a3d-9c17-02ac1939cd0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This is why even post Civil War, Black Americans were forced to build Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) to ensure Black children could attain education. When W.E.B. Dubois (1868-1963) made history in 189as the first Black PhD graduate of Harvard University, he famously and correctly said, "The honor, I assure you, was Harvard's."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/65273110-cf43-45b1-96a7-0fa305c7ecf1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Carl Van Vechten, (C) Van Vechten Trust. Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library, Yale University
Affirmative Action required universities and corporations to finally also consider non-white applicants when making hiring decisions. To repeat, Affirmative Action did not force universities and corporations to accept unqualified women and Black people--it required them to _also_ consider qualified women and Black people. And the ample data backs up how such diversity has historically [benefitted the economy and innovation](https://substack.com/redirect/914efc24-ce3a-4d2f-a78a-d761c1bfc4d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on a national and international level. And claims that we are somehow "post-racial" are backed not by facts or evidence, but meritless opinions.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..sOLH50YAL1fev6LKUBvw3vrP0WqRmFc7hKcTZhHpJQU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144793664)
**Finally, point out that if conservatives truly objected to unqualified admissions or acceptances, they would have attacked and repealed Legacy Admissions, not Affirmative Action.** The receipts make this clear. For example, while conservatives protested the 8% Black students at Harvard, Legacy Admissions and sports admissions accounted for 43% of white students accepted to Harvard. And shockingly, 75% of those students would _not_ have qualified or been accepted on merit. As reported by Vox, one study by the National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER) [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/cd23d54c-eec6-40cd-9e09-4b92f19a1e39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Among white students admitted to Harvard, 43 percent received a preference for athletics, legacy status, being on the dean's interest list, or for being the child of a faculty or staff member, and without those advantages, three-quarters would have been rejected.
In other words, if the conservative outrage was truly about the lack of meritocracy, their exclusive target should have been Legacy Admissions. Even if we go with the false claim that every single person Black admitted was admitted due to Affirmative Action and was unqualified, the number of those admissions still dwarfs in comparison to the unqualified white Legacy students admitted.
Yet, complete silence from conservatives on this fact. I cannot imagine why.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0c42fb1e-9868-4f30-96fb-49770e57dc3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Credit: https://library.law.howard.edu/civilrightshistory/blackrights/desegregation
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=144793664&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ0NzkzNjY0LCJpYXQiOjE3MTcwNzQzNzYsImV4cCI6MTcxOTY2NjM3NiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.Sl2SKxIB4VFCaGacCuVG35xJsKvTRvWwvi8G2yp1Or8)
In conclusion, I'm hopeful the above facts help you at the inevitable conversation with a conservative family member or friend who has bought into the right wing propaganda about Affirmative Action. Indeed, the facts do not lie. The movement to repeal Affirmative Action, or ban DEI, or demonize CRT--was never about merit and was never about applicant qualifications. It was always about reviving Jim Crow white supremacy. And the scary part is--so far--it is working.

Affirmative Action was always about ensuring underrepresented qualified people also had a fair shot at acceptance. Universities and corporations systemically discriminated against non-white applicants for the entirety of American history up through Jim Crow. | | ---|---|--- This is why even post Civil War, Black Americans were forced to build Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) to ensure Black children could attain education. When W.E.B. Dubois (1868-1963) made history in 189as the first Black PhD graduate of Harvard University, he famously and correctly said, "The honor, I assure you, was Harvard's." | | ---|---|--- Carl Van Vechten, (C) Van Vechten Trust. Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library, Yale University Affirmative Action required universities and corporations to finally also consider non-white applicants when making hiring decisions. To repeat, Affirmative Action did not force universities and corporations to accept unqualified women and Black people--it required them to also consider qualified women and Black people. And the ample data backs up how such diversity has historically on a national and international level. And claims that we are somehow "post-racial" are backed not by facts or evidence, but meritless opinions. Finally, point out that if conservatives truly objected to unqualified admissions or acceptances, they would have attacked and repealed Legacy Admissions, not Affirmative Action. The receipts make this clear. For example, while conservatives protested the 8% Black students at Harvard, Legacy Admissions and sports admissions accounted for 43% of white students accepted to Harvard. And shockingly, 75% of those students would not have qualified or been accepted on merit. As reported by Vox, one study by the National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER) : Among white students admitted to Harvard, 43 percent received a preference for athletics, legacy status, being on the dean's interest list, or for being the child of a faculty or staff member, and without those advantages, three-quarters would have been rejected. In other words, if the conservative outrage was truly about the lack of meritocracy, their exclusive target should have been Legacy Admissions. Even if we go with the false claim that every single person Black admitted was admitted due to Affirmative Action and was unqualified, the number of those admissions still dwarfs in comparison to the unqualified white Legacy students admitted. Yet, complete silence from conservatives on this fact. I cannot imagine why. | | ---|---|--- Credit: In conclusion, I'm hopeful the above facts help you at the inevitable conversation with a conservative family member or friend who has bought into the right wing propaganda about Affirmative Action. Indeed, the facts do not lie. The movement to repeal Affirmative Action, or ban DEI, or demonize CRT--was never about merit and was never about applicant qualifications. It was always about reviving Jim Crow white supremacy. And the scary part is--so far--it is working. Let's Address This is a reader-supported publication. As a member of Congress, Andy stood up for our families by working tirelessly to lower costs for us. Fellow Conservative,

Hollywood funding Democrat candidates for Congress and the White House is a tale as old as the movie industry itself.

The latest example of this? Robert De Niro bashing President Trump in an email sent from the Biden campaign Wednesday. In his missive De Niro says, _**"Thank God Joe Biden defeated Trump and restored decency, compassion, and honest, intelligent leadership to the presidency."**_

You and I both know how rare it is for a celebrity in Hollywood to support conservative candidates for federal office - it’s even more rare for them to offer their support publicly. But quite frankly, I couldn’t care less about winning the support of Hollywood actors, directors, or anyone involved with the entertainment industry.

**My opponent, on the other hand, is actively soliciting their financial support.**

I have received emails from actress Glenn Close on two occasions. In her fundraising appeals on behalf of Jon Tester’s campaign, she writes, _**“Jon Tester is running for reelection in Montana—it’s the most important race on the map. This election will determine the future of our country, and I can’t sit on the sidelines with stakes as high as these.”**_

subject: I need your help to defeat Josh Hawley this year, Peter

body:
We’re going to flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat and put working people in charge of our country. Please let me explain how we got here.
#
I’m so proud of the movement we’ve built together, Peter.
From calling out Josh Hawley on cable news to breaking fundraising records and earning major endorsements from organizations like the Missouri AFL-CIO, End Citizens United, and League of Conservation Voters, we’ve put a national spotlight on Missouri’s U.S. Senate race.
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to add your first donation of any amount toward my campaign to defeat Hawley and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat. **But first, please let me share a little more about how we got here.**
**[ADD A DONATION NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51300?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0)**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51300?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0)
I grew up in mid-Missouri. And like so many other Americans, my family lived paycheck-to-paycheck. So when my little sister was born with a heart condition, the medical bills bankrupted us. Maxed-out credit cards and no money left, times had never been tougher.
But we weren’t alone — our community took care of us. When my parents had to take my sister to the hospital in St. Louis, our neighbors and friends took my siblings and me into their homes and brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat. **That’s the Missouri I grew up in.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51300?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0)
Their support helped send me to college, and after that I joined the Marines to honor everything they had done for me and my family growing up. Got deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan. Later the Pentagon. I was on the Joint Staff negotiating arms control agreements with NATO and Russia.
When I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, one of the hardest things was seeing what was happening back in my old neighborhood. It was a community picked for parts — the local corner store boarded up, my first family house bulldozed to the ground. **Here’s all that’s left of it:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51300?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0)
While all of us were risking our lives building up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians like Josh Hawley let our country waste away. They spent trillions on bailouts, tax breaks, and subsidies for the industries that stripped our communities for parts — like Wall Street, Big Pharma, and Big Oil — and then told us they can’t figure out how to invest even a fraction of that into building up our own country and investing in our own people.
**I saw what was happening — and I was ready to fight back.**
So in my final year of active duty, I worked to upend the corporate defense monopolies that leave our country less safe. I also joined an organization that fights corporate monopolies — we took on defense contractors, Big Pharma, Big Tech, Big Ag, Wall Street. The people buying off our politicians and leaving the rest of us behind.
**And now, I’m running for U.S. Senate to replace Josh Hawley and fundamentally change who has power in our country** — so everyday people call the shots, not massive corporations or corrupt politicians. I want to abolish corporate PACs, expose lobbyists writing our laws, criminalize war profiteering, ban insider trading among members of Congress, and enact a Marshall Plan for the Midwest — a massive investment and job creation program that will rebuild our forgotten communities and get us off fossil fuels once and for all.
I want to codify Roe v. Wade, secure voting rights, and ban anti-union “Right-to-Work” scams forever. I want to put working people in charge of our country. But I need your help to get it done.
**Without a single cent of corporate PAC money, we’re building the people-powered movement that’s going to defeat Josh Hawley and flip this Senate seat — and I need you on our team.[Please add a donation of any amount right now so we can continue building this movement and finally give power back to everyday, working people.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51300?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51301?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=6&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51301?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=7&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51300?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=8&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0)
---
I’m not just running to make a point — **this is a race we can win.**
**Josh Hawley is vulnerable.** In 2018, he won his seat with only 51% of the vote — and after he exposed himself to be a fraud and a coward on January 6th, he became the least popular Republican Senator up for re-election in 2024.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51300?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0)
Since Hawley was elected, Missourians have broken with him and taken back their power at the ballot box by voting to raise the minimum wage, expand Medicaid through the Affordable Care Act, and legalize cannabis. And this year, with an initiative to end Missouri’s extreme abortion ban going on the ballot, we expect even more voters to turn out and protect their freedom this November.
So if we’re able to communicate to voters that our campaign is about taking back power for real Missourians, we have a real shot at defeating Josh Hawley.
**But I need you on this team to get it done, Peter.** National insiders and even Hawley’s own campaign have already started attacking me — and over the coming months, they’re bound to get even more vicious. That’s why we need to start preparing right now to fight back and deliver our positive message to voters.
**[Will you chip in anything you can right now so we can keep building this record-breaking grassroots movement and stay prepared for the fight ahead? I don’t take a cent from corporate PACs, so I mean it when I say anything makes a big difference to our campaign.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51300?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51301?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=11&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51301?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=12&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51301?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=13&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51301?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=14&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51301?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=15&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51301?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=16&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/51300?refcode=em20240530-5637&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=17&akid=5637%2E614464%2E2YGMB0)
---
Together, we can take back power from corrupt politicians like Josh Hawley and finally put real, everyday people in charge of our country.
Thanks for helping us get it done,
Lucas Kunce

| | | | , Today is Brad’s birthday.
If you haven’t already, will you please sign Brad’s card and rush in a special campaign gift to help reach our May fundraising goal?
We’re still about $5,600 short!

| Fellow Conservative,

Our fundraising operation always takes a hit over holiday weekends. And we get it. People are busy and need to put away their phones and laptops.

As someone who travels back and forth between Ohio and Washington, D.C., every week of the year, I understand the need to decouple from electronics from time to time and focus on the family. Even though we knew we would have to contend with the looming end-of-month fundraising (**occurring tomorrow**), I instructed my team to refrain from emailing from last Friday to today.

As I’ve said before, texts and emails like this one are a necessary evil in the political world. With Democrats having perfected the art of small-dollar fundraising (_**They’ve outraised every Republican candidate and officeholder for several cycles now**_), it’s incumbent on you and me to do what we can to ensure campaigns like mine are fully funded.

[**CHIP IN $1 OR $2**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=8996aa5d21aa48c4b40df3fba7a14f53&_e=0HLgjPyROxPjrNb4cjvHUXqLYxdo46inj4humSIfAHEBleCTksaVht7x2HKBqJwmUBBAMGHwo37hgTzUpsLPjvgkL_Yfx-rwx2_bm6OnGgWgG1k5wQSCfOUnP1f008CJ8u3UcXn0DWIUOjIRzKWVE2ZWBiJwpowJ6pb_jJxl9G6bD54Ds1tDkNYIrvcMceTn2lxrLqhDcJUpEJrphXJnyzqFR95QBg7vZ6eScZ-n6GeTvEib3roOu_SxvX1MuITbGFVDF6wj9__huUZasoqoLcpnwnq7Z03Hnp9DNhds4T8OThN2YCvePU-FEraUY1FL1avwgjp86qVAxx7U43KH_kkEKjTpzP9Ys5l3jgBk8LJDR9hxRO0rdBOsxhBr6YC2y73YVoRfNoY6_GZgYi_gJA%3D%3D)

**About Jim Jordan:** | Leading the fight to hold Washington accountable.

**Jordan helped found and was elected by his colleagues to chair the House Freedom Caucus. Jordan is focused on his oversight role, helping lead investigations into federal agencies, including the IRS.**

In Congress, Jim Jordan continued to fight for fiscal responsibility, authoring the “Cut, Cap and Balance” plan get the country’s finances back on track. As a budget committee member he offered more spending cuts than any other Member of Congress, and as RSC Budget/Spending Task Force Chairman, he offered the only balanced budget of any member of the House or Senate.

As a state legislator, he took on the powerful special interests and the leaders from both political parties who wanted to put Ohio on an unsustainable path of higher taxes and spending.

He built a conservative, pro-family voting record, and authored an alternative state budget that balanced without raising taxes. He became the only legislator in state history to win both the Defender of Life award from Ohio Right to Life and the Pro-Life Legislator of the Year award from the United Conservatives of Ohio.

# Why Frederick Douglass?
---
| **A Force for Uniting the United States:** Frederick Douglass serves as a powerful symbol for Republicans to promote the values and principles that make our nation unique. He was born into slavery in 1818, but later became one of the leading advocates for reuniting our nation as the Civil War came to an end. His strong conviction in the power of our founding values and constitutional principles, along with his self-learned eloquence, helped guide Abraham Lincoln and the recently formed Republican party to win a second term based on these values and principles. Lincoln faced the daunting challenge of rescuing a nation divided by the Civil War.
**Believed in American Principles:** History tells us that Lincoln's wholehearted embrace of Douglass's message of fighting for and preserving the values that formed our nation was not only the winning message, but also the roadmap for reunification. Today, as our nation becomes increasingly fragmented along political issues and divergent views of our fundamental values and principles of freedom, engaging people based on this former slave's unassailable historical contribution offers the most effective messaging for winning new hearts and minds.
**A Symbol of Republican Values:** Just as Lincoln turned to Douglass for guiding the salvation of America, Republicans can leverage Douglass as a pivotal symbol for fully realizing the greatness of our country. In a historical context, emulating Lincoln and using the impactful legacy of Frederick Douglass serves to open the door to all voters to find common ground and reunite our country.
**Frederick Douglass played a crucial role in the birth of the Republican Party:** The Republican Party was founded in 1854 by abolitionists who aimed to end slavery and advocate for the civil rights of Black people, with Frederick Douglass playing a significant role in initiating the political campaign.

| Dear Fellow American,

I want to alert you to recent developments on three critically important **Judicial Watch** legal battlegrounds...which illustrate how our biggest caseload _ever_ is putting us on the front lines in the battles for the rule of law and government transparency.
And **[I respectfully ask you to consider a special contribution today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68495&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)** so that we can keep the pressure on all these fronts!
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68495&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

**First** , we filed a class action lawsuit last week in federal court against Evanston, Illinois, over the city's use of race as an eligibility requirement for a **reparations program** which makes $25,000 payments to black residents and descendants of black residents who lived in Evanston between 1919 and 1969.

This program is nothing more than a ploy to redistribute tax dollars to individuals based on race...and it unconstitutionally discriminates against anyone who does not identify as Black or African American.

We believe that "no discrimination based on race" means "no discrimination based on race." Our lawsuit will be a historic defense of our color-blind Constitution!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68495&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

**Second,** last week we also filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit against the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) for _official emails_ in the _personal email account_ of Dr. David Morens, a senior advisor to Dr. Anthony Fauci, when Fauci was director of the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases during the COVID-19 pandemic.

We sued because HHS _stonewalled_ our original FOIA request, after it was revealed that Dr. Morens _intentionally used his personal email to hide conversations about the origins of COVID-19 and subvert federal transparency laws_. **Judicial Watch** broke open Hillary Clinton's improper use of personal email servers to do official business when she was Secretary of State...and we will not let other government officials violate federal law in order to circumvent the people's "right to know" and avoid accountability for their actions!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68495&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

**Third** , in response to a **Judicial Watch** FOIA request, two weeks ago we received records from the District of Columbia that _explain to illegal aliens and other noncitizens how they can register to vote in Washington, DC elections_!

Our release of these shocking documents _put renewed pressure_ on Congress, which oversees DC, to act responsibly and overturn this practice. _Illegal aliens and noncitizens should not vote in any elections_...and thankfully, one week ago a _bipartisan majority_ in the House of Representatives overturned the DC law, although a fight awaits in the Senate.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68495&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Friends,
The state of Idaho held their primary elections last Tuesday and the Establishment worked overtime to try to defeat our Idaho Freedom Caucus members.
RINOs and the corporate interests that dominate the state spent over a million dollars to take out the true conservative fighters who achieved so much success in the last legislative session, which included the [historic budget reforms that we previously wrote about.](https://substack.com/redirect/2207c313-adc8-4da0-8fbd-5c736d57dd93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Idaho's RINO Gov. Brad Little even instructed Senate Pro Temp. Chuck Winder to target four of our IDFC State Senators.
We wrote last November about how Winder [removed several of our members](https://substack.com/redirect/60a97aba-522d-46cb-b401-1395028d6b21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from committee leadership positions after criticizing him.
Specifically, he removed IDFC member Sen. Glenneda Zuiderveld from Vice Chair of the Health and Welfare Committee after she wrote a newsletter criticizing the power that corporate interests have in the legislature.
Well, the voters were paying attention. Chuck Winder went down in flames in his primary. Glenneda won hers by nine points.
**This was the overall trend in Idaho 's primaries.**
Unfortunately, their efforts resulted in two IDFC members losing their primaries - State Senator Scott Herndon and State Rep. Jacyn Gallagher.
Overall, however, conservatives made tremendous gains all across the state.
While the dust is still settling, last Tuesday's primaries **will absolutely result in net growth in the Idaho Freedom Caucus.**

I recently did an interview with Daniel Horowitz from The Blaze to discuss the successes of our State Freedom Caucuses from around the country.

Additionally, I also appeared on The Federalist Radio Hour to discuss our work.

# **What Reproductive Justice Looks Like in 2024**
---
| Dear friends, The status of reproductive rights in America has never been bleaker. Texas and Alabama have passed laws which endanger women and threaten their ability to conceive. Late in 2023,**** ABC News __ aired a special on the harrowing experiences of women in states with abortion bans and how the complicated legal landscape is contributing to human suffering. In the special, several women gathered to tell their stories and connect with their trauma. Some of these women had struggled with infertility for years and were more than joyful to become mothers. However, with each story of joy came an ending in grief and heartache. All of the women present experienced some form of congenital disability in their pregnancy, a pregnancy that would not result in a live birth or a birth that would be followed quickly by the death of their baby. These women could not obtain the care they needed in their home states or went through burdensome steps to pursue that healthcare. Some of them were quite **literally at death's door before hospital staff felt it legally acceptable to provide them with a procedure.**
---
|
---
| This is what the reality of a post-Roe America looks like in 2024. We live in a country where, as one woman phrased it,**people are "medical refugees."**
---
|
# **Clarifying Exceptions**
---
| In states with less-than-clear exceptions and medical exemptions, the stories of women are becoming louder. Women in states with bans are more at risk than ever, while states such as Alabama are criminalising IVF. Per the _New York Times_ :_**"**__**Emergency room doctors in Texas are not required to perform emergency abortions despite federal guidance...**__**The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit affirmed a ruling that sided with the State of Texas, which had sued the Biden administration, arguing that the federal guidance issued in 2022 was an overstep that would "force abortions."**_ Lawmakers in these states are also fighting against clarifications to the laws and exemptions for medical emergencies, citing fears of things becoming too "broad." In Louisiana (as covered in _On the Brink),_ House Bill 461 and House Bill 598 sought to make circumstances like ectopic pregnancies and premature fetal death legal under the state's abortion ban. The Louisiana House, however, rejected both measures and, like other states, has created a legal and moral limbo for patients and doctors.
---
|
# **SCOTUS on Mifepristone**
---
| In anticipation of what could be the next phase of broad abortion bans dependent solely on a SCOTUS ruling, more women nationwide who aren't pregnant are buying abortion medication, according to a new study. From an analysis by the _New York Times_ : _**"The biggest spikes in demand followed events that raised doubts about the future availability of abortion.**__**Requests peaked in the weeks between the leak and the Supreme Court's decision in June 2022, and in April 2023 after a flurry of court rulings in a lawsuit by abortion opponents seeking to curtail**_ _**mifepristone, a key abortion pill**_ _**, a case now before the Supreme Court.**__**Rates of requests were highest in states where abortion bans were expected — even higher than in states that already had bans."**_ The Supreme Court is expected to weigh in on the mifepristone case, including a lower court ruling, by the summer's end. Until then, more challenges to different avenues of abortion access are more than likely to play out in courts across the country. clean_body: A look at the harrowing experiences of women in states with abortion bans, and how the complicated legal landscape contributes to human suffering | | | | | | | | | What Reproductive Justice Looks Like in 2024 | Dear friends, The status of reproductive rights in America has never been bleaker. Texas and Alabama have passed laws which endanger women and threaten their ability to conceive. Late in 2023,** ABC News aired a special on the harrowing experiences of women in states with abortion bans and how the complicated legal landscape is contributing to human suffering. In the special, several women gathered to tell their stories and connect with their trauma. Some of these women had struggled with infertility for years and were more than joyful to become mothers. However, with each story of joy came an ending in grief and heartache. All of the women present experienced some form of congenital disability in their pregnancy, a pregnancy that would not result in a live birth or a birth that would be followed quickly by the death of their baby. These women could not obtain the care they needed in their home states or went through burdensome steps to pursue that healthcare. Some of them were quite literally at death's door before hospital staff felt it legally acceptable to provide them with a procedure. | | This is what the reality of a post-Roe America looks like in 2024. We live in a country where, as one woman phrased it,people are "medical refugees." | Clarifying Exceptions | In states with less-than-clear exceptions and medical exemptions, the stories of women are becoming louder. Women in states with bans are more at risk than ever, while states such as Alabama are criminalising IVF. Per the New York Times :"Emergency room doctors in Texas are not required to perform emergency abortions despite federal guidance...The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit affirmed a ruling that sided with the State of Texas, which had sued the Biden administration, arguing that the federal guidance issued in 2022 was an overstep that would "force abortions." Lawmakers in these states are also fighting against clarifications to the laws and exemptions for medical emergencies, citing fears of things becoming too "broad." In Louisiana (as covered in On the Brink), House Bill 461 and House Bill 598 sought to make circumstances like ectopic pregnancies and premature fetal death legal under the state's abortion ban. The Louisiana House, however, rejected both measures and, like other states, has created a legal and moral limbo for patients and doctors. | SCOTUS on Mifepristone | In anticipation of what could be the next phase of broad abortion bans dependent solely on a SCOTUS ruling, more women nationwide who aren't pregnant are buying abortion medication, according to a new study. From an analysis by the New York Times : "The biggest spikes in demand followed events that raised doubts about the future availability of abortion.Requests peaked in the weeks between the leak and the Supreme Court's decision in June 2022, and in April 2023 after a flurry of court rulings in a lawsuit by abortion opponents seeking to curtail mifepristone, a key abortion pill , a case now before the Supreme Court.Rates of requests were highest in states where abortion bans were expected — even higher than in states that already had bans." The Supreme Court is expected to weigh in on the mifepristone case, including a lower court ruling, by the summer's end. Until then, more challenges to different avenues of abortion access are more than likely to play out in courts across the country. | If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | In this together,Anna Scudder Reproductive Health & Justice Correspondent No Dem Left Behind** | | | | | The Roe Report | No Dem Left Behind PAC 80M St. SE Suite 100 Washington D.C. 20003 | | | ---|---|--- | Paid for by No Dem Left Behind PAC. And if there’s one thing we’ve learned already about this election, it’s that people are ready for change and want to learn more about the candidates seeking to represent them in the Missouri Senate.
Joe is a man who lives his values and practices what he preaches. As a strong supporter of unions and a believer in the dignity of work, Joe has insisted that everyone working for him must always earn what they deserve. Our field staff are essential members of the team, tasked with representing Joe and everything this campaign stands for in front of thousands of constituents and voters.
So, with that in mind, we wanted to share some of the math behind our field program budget and ask for your support so that we can grow this team and build a formidable door-to-door field program that can get Joe elected to the State Senate in November . [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=field]

With just 22 weeks left until the General Election, the total cost of funding two teams of canvassers would be $7,040.
If we can raise $7,040 (or more) now, we can cover the entire cost of two teams of trained, professional field staff out in the community, in the district, knocking doors and getting Joe’s message to swing voters every week from now until Election Day in November .

**Now, in 2024, my friend Jacky Rosen is a woman at the table fighting for us in the U.S. Senate — but Republicans and their billionaire donors are targeting her for defeat in battleground Nevada!**

Not only that, Jacky is a champion and a leader in the Senate advocating for reproductive freedom.
**Republicans are coming after Jacky as a top target because they want to take us back to the 1950s.** Right-wing Supreme Court justices overturned women’s long-established right to privacy and reproductive freedom. Republican legislators are vowing to pass a law banning abortion in every state. They came for IVF, and now they’re coming for contraception.

[**We need to keep Jacky Rosen in the Senate to stand up for our fundamental freedoms, end the gender pay gap, and fight for our families. So, please donate now. Your donation could be the difference!**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85916710/476276085/1514755465?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3847-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OGIzMzZjYy05ODFlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CkOrSjqsAzqgdonafVsiyKIzR99v8AkVIF-noEtDTQQ=)
**Okay, friend, we’re here. Our democracy is at flashing-red-light risk.**
Donald Trump is already promising to be a dictator on day one if he wins again. And Jacky’s MAGA opponent in this crucial Senate race is an anti-abortion extremist who brags that Trump inspired him to run for office. We know the path to winning the Senate and the White House goes right through Nevada – and a return to Republican control would be an absolute disaster for our country. With so much on the line, we must do everything we can to ensure that doesn’t happen.
**[The November election is our chance to show the world that a decisive majority of Americans reject MAGA extremism—and keeping Jacky Rosen in the Senate is crucial to that outcome!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85916711/476276086/1514755465?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3847-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OGIzMzZjYy05ODFlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CkOrSjqsAzqgdonafVsiyKIzR99v8AkVIF-noEtDTQQ=)**

Thank you for being part of our movement in whatever ways you can. Don’t give up. We can do this!
My best to you and your family,

– Carole
