Peter,

After the _Dobbs_ decision, Virginia has become the last bastion in the South for protecting reproductive freedom — thanks to our Democratic-held General Assembly.

Already, Virginia clinics have seen a sharp increase in out-of-state patients who have been forced to travel across state lines to receive the care they need.

As extreme politicians across the country seek to pass further restrictions on family planning, reproductive healthcare, contraception, and more, **we must make sure that reproductive care remains safe and accessible across Virginia.**

That means protecting both patients and providers and keeping these personal decisions between patients and their medical providers, not extreme politicians or judges.

body:
Polling is a notoriously fickle science, especially since it’s still early, but this data underscores a fundamental truth: Michigan is a swing state, and swing states have a tendency to...swing.

| Friend,

I wanted to make sure you saw this recent polling for the U.S. Senate race here in Michigan. Bottom line: We are in a statistical dead-heat against one of the leading Republicans, Mike Rogers — with a ton of Michigan swing voters still undecided. Elissa Slotkin: 39.8%
Mike Rogers: 36.8%
Undecided: 23.3% Polling is a notoriously fickle science, especially since it’s still early, but this data underscores a fundamental truth: Michigan is a swing state, and swing states have a tendency to...swing. Despite Democrats’ success in recent years, we know it can flip red under the right conditions.

So in light of this poll, I want to ask if you’ll consider making a $3 contribution to my campaign.

$3, because recent polling has us in a statistical tie against a Trump-endorsed candidate.

$3, because Democrats only have a 51 seat majority in the U.S. Senate, and with Joe Manchin’s retirement and a likely flip in West Virginia, we need to hold onto this seat for Democrats to retain control of the body.

$3, because our race is the top of the ticket in Michigan — which means what happens will likely have an impact on the presidential race here as well.

$3, because more than 1 in 5 voters are undecided in our race, and we need to be able to talk to those voters in all 11 of Michigan’s media markets.

I wouldn’t ask if it wasn’t important, but there are less than 6 months left until Election Day and contributions from people like you in response to emails like this represent the bulk of the money we raise — which means your support is critical to getting us over the finish line.

| A **recently uncovered** Facebook comment made from the personal account of Susan Wild shows her _**once again disparaging one of her constituents.**_
Wild posted her latest offensive comment from her own personal Facebook page, apparently thinking no one would notice.
After attending a recent Memorial Day event where she received a chilly response, **Wild was left steaming mad about a veteran who did not want to shake her hand.**
In response, it seems she took to Facebook to vent, commenting on a photo that included an American flag and a “Progress Pride” flag: “I suspect that the vet who refused to shake my hand today at a Memorial Day event would not approve of your second flag.”

Fellow American,

I’m Kevin Lincoln, the conservative Republican who is running to defeat leftist Josh Harder in California’s highly-targeted 9th Congressional District – _one of the most competitive House races in the country._

**I’m a Marine Corps veteran, mayor of my hometown of Stockton, a proud father & husband, and I’m running to rescue American families and workers from Washington D.C.’s broken politics.**

[ ** Send a Marine & Mayor to Congress ➞ **](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=908311973dfa4b54b0fcce815bcb9ddc&_e=7taJsF8cnp-pAip9uzDexBI0yuNq8XC7iNE3dln7Bm5V1F5Q3wsYfEsd-toJKnvGnZoKsa86fhOFcQJB0evMzQ7e52durFCwzL0GVLGLk5DSl73BTuUMjL58mVRNhhAYEBW4_8CLZf6sEVjxFgD9YwxX67D0wl2OBFZd76JUIiCMsMkURgpEdvG3FGcufGD2CstmtPksU4RJDM_Bh6gZVDkQ0PuOmPFRpL1peXL5lz-7-mcP5MfVn47PZIZs9p3UhAr1ZwcYrsouMEilWFc3pK7MVuOGBOdVlSNDjyrb8RQzcmuBb85qMakCUIVkfKID_ee0Ev5peXzina2Ds9quK3Ln_HbUx8wJafLt-o-40KesQKjlx-j-kbxeME2Zf7emITuX2bK3iesFyS-yZQGKpA%3D%3D)
Service has always defined my life. I joined the United States Marine Corps in 2001 and became a military police officer.

After 9/11, I was assigned to Marine One to serve and protect the President of the United States.

When I completed my military service, I graduated from college while working full time and raising a family. But my urge to serve hadn’t gone. I continued to serve my community as a pastor and as a non-profit leader.

**Now, one of the greatest honors of my life is being able to serve as the Mayor of my hometown of Stockton, California.**

As Mayor, my team and I have revitalized our local economy, attracted businesses that have created jobs, balanced our budget, tackled homelessness, and reduced violent crime.

America as a whole is suffering these same problems, but the politicians in the White House and Congress don’t have what it takes to fix them.

**I do, and that’s why I’m running for Congress. My country needs me again, and I’m ready to serve.**

[**Will you send in a Marine and mayor to fix Washington’s broken politics and get our country back on track by supporting my campaign with a $5, $10 or $15 contribution today?**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=908311973dfa4b54b0fcce815bcb9ddc&_e=7taJsF8cnp-pAip9uzDexBI0yuNq8XC7iNE3dln7Bm5V1F5Q3wsYfEsd-toJKnvGnZoKsa86fhOFcQJB0evMzQ7e52durFCwzL0GVLGLk5DSl73BTuUMjL58mVRNhhAYEBW4_8CLZf6sEVjxFgD9YwxX67D0wl2OBFZd76JUIiCMsMkURgpEdvG3FGcufGD2CstmtPksU4RJDM_Bh6gZVDkQ0PuOmPFRpL1peXL5lz-I-x7fdGOfM0s4LHoGtN10FdoY4vZcI6mgtaqbpM01LpfjMgKT48Qz6EUYS_QMiyBB43W97eSOEthwJluOxHJqhBJ2nXJpNk729KLdtmywO99sXoQuUe9Pu4qNqfQCvdtz3OJtSzb4gUwVYRX6wD7TSa1FCU5toiModv9KJL4AQQ%3D%3D)

[ ** Send a Marine & Mayor to Congress ➞ **](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=908311973dfa4b54b0fcce815bcb9ddc&_e=7taJsF8cnp-pAip9uzDexBI0yuNq8XC7iNE3dln7Bm5V1F5Q3wsYfEsd-toJKnvGnZoKsa86fhOFcQJB0evMzQ7e52durFCwzL0GVLGLk5DSl73BTuUMjL58mVRNhhAYEBW4_8CLZf6sEVjxFgD9YwxX67D0wl2OBFZd76JUIiCMsMkURgpEdvG3FGcufGD2CstmtPksU4RJDM_Bh6gZVDkQ0PuOmPFRpL1peXL5lz-8PRm4qT1-B6FxXHpMP8IvJgtAa5wxgtuwLUgReIUWu5mYbND1KomDZo4mXnhk6EooSbah2kadeKBX_Oe-cl_L0SZt3Y-5Jalk33v-GCxzpaWDt4KT-AvBFyH4SRw__YlWC2CsZruaKvv5zKY6PP41J-Y-2IqWccEIVCHj98dqFQ%3D%3D)
Career politicians like Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi and Josh Harder have created the mess we’re in, so why would we think they could get us out of it?

We need to get inflation under control, revive our economy, reprioritize public safety, support our veterans, and make the politicians in Washington D.C. work for and serve the American people once again.

**California’s 9th Congressional District is a toss-up, top-target House seat and one of our best chances to defeat a career Democrat politician and restore conservative representation.**

[**But I need your help to win the fight so I can make it to Congress and get to work. Will you send in a Marine and mayor? Please join me today with a contribution of just $5, $10, $15 or more.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=908311973dfa4b54b0fcce815bcb9ddc&_e=7taJsF8cnp-pAip9uzDexBI0yuNq8XC7iNE3dln7Bm5V1F5Q3wsYfEsd-toJKnvGnZoKsa86fhOFcQJB0evMzQ7e52durFCwzL0GVLGLk5DSl73BTuUMjL58mVRNhhAYEBW4_8CLZf6sEVjxFgD9YwxX67D0wl2OBFZd76JUIiCMsMkURgpEdvG3FGcufGD2CstmtPksU4RJDM_Bh6gZVDkQ0PuOmPFRpL1peXL5lz8T2WUtAS07y-IwK3TMGJG2UgvFzjw162w2QRiPS_i6fbb1MZQEAJPz71I1_6GoQdeHeE-7dJgL66pZoGhP3_mAy8Bpu9tWSA_BGsyUUxE7wkgPR2en7eoLvOXvrPdOQEK1W2jHBiENJeL1omeW_vs1Bk2oI9yz9e1VmKmwHD2DWA%3D%3D)

**Kevin Lincoln**
Veteran, USMC

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: Thank you!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Hi friends – I wanted to take a moment to say thanks.
I’m almost three-quarters of the way through my second term in Congress – and less than six months away from my next election – and today, I find myself reflecting on how much this team means to me.
One thing you hear about when you’re running for Congress is that House members are on a constant campaign loop – that with a two-year term, you spend all of your time both serving and running, because your next election is always right around the corner.
And I have to say – if there is any group of supporters who could make that constant campaigning actually fun , it’s this one. I absolutely love spending time with voters in San Diego, I have such a great time with our local Democratic clubs, and I really enjoy the relationship we’ve built right here on the internet.
It’s not lost on me that having a genuine back-and-forth of meaningful ideas isn’t exactly the norm in political email programs, and it wouldn’t be possible without everyone on this team making it a priority.
So thank you! Thanks for everything you do in your neighborhood and community, and thanks for everything you do online and via email to share feedback, offer words of encouragement, and weigh in on the issues.
My least favorite part of campaigning is, of course, the fundraising. It’s tough, it’s never-ending, and it’s definitely not as much fun as canvassing or phonebanking.
But it’s absolutely necessary. In order for Democrats to deliver the victories we need in November, we’ve got to boost our fundraising numbers. I’m sure you saw the news that Trump and the RNC outraised President Biden and the DNC last month – so now is not the time to tune out.
If you can, please pitch in with an online contribution of $25, $50, or whatever you can before we close the books on May tomorrow at midnight. Your donations are such an important part of building a winning campaign! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thank you so much.
-Sara
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Congresswoman Sara Jacobs
California’s 51st District

I appreciate you taking the time to read these emails and stay connected with my campaign – regardless of whether or not you’re able to chip in financially. Thank you!

Friend,
Right now, it seems like poll after poll is coming out showing Trump leading in key swing states. Surveys from the New York Times, Siena College, and the Philadelphia Inquirer found that Trump is leading President Biden in Michigan, Arizona, Nevada, Georgia, and Pennsylvania.
I wanted to share my thoughts about it.
These are key swing states — and while polls aren’t perfect, we can’t ignore what these numbers tell us.
We have less than six months until the election. To avoid a Trump presidency, we need to connect with voters in key swing states over the coming months and talk about the issues that really matter — lowering costs, protecting the right to choose, and building an economy that works for everyone.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_53024_EOM_A_polls_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_53024_EOM_A_polls_act]
Donald Trump is a threat to our country and our democracy. He’ll drag our country backward.
If he wins the presidential race, he will work to ban abortion, loosen gun safety regulations, pass tax breaks for billionaires and corporations, and continue to destroy our democratic norms. We know this because it is what he has done in the past and what he is promising to do again.
By supporting President Biden and Democrats running in swing seats, we can energize voters and defeat Trumpism. But we can’t do it alone — and we must stay focused on what connects us, not what divides us.
If you’d like to support my work to elect President Biden and Democrats in key swing seats, and defeat Donald Trump, you can chip in here. My campaign has a fundraising deadline in one day, and we need your help to hit our goal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_53024_EOM_A_polls_act]
I appreciate your support in this critical work. Thank you for being part of our team.

Michael

body:
| | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240528_we_filed&n=1)
---
Friend -- On Tuesday May 28th, we filed approximately 70,000 signatures with the New York State Board of Elections, well over the 45,000 requirement. I want to thank each of the 200-plus individuals who were involved in collecting signatures, from those of you we met on the campaign trail who collected signatures from friends and family, to those of you who sweated, froze, got rained on for day after day to meet the outrageous signature threshold mandated by the State of New York for ballot access for non-major-party candidates and independents such as myself. Unlike presidential candidates Robert Kennedy, Jr., and Jill Stein of the Green Party, I am proud to say that my campaign did not hire a single "professional petitioner," but depended on the impassioned support of people like you, who recognize the great moment of decision faced by our nation, and the horrifying consequences of not getting the United States off the trajectory of confrontation with Russia and China, but rather, moving into the paradigm defined by Lyndon LaRouche and his wife, Helga, of productive cooperation with the rest of the world based on respect for the sovereignty of each nation and the dignity of humankind -- every human, not just particular ones. Below are photos from the filing in Albany[, ](https://www.sareforsenate.com/sare_campaign_files_petitions_blog?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240528_we_filed&n=2)[and here is a video of the reception](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=2PNlHEbVYFsh-F_FzIY8nQ-MRpzp8V7qYL1q2EDSKQ8gcIEnlLyxrFx9PHLRhZ2WT65UhoVEhYHgKwdZ7IVB9Q&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240528_we_filed&n=3)[,](https://www.sareforsenate.com/sare_campaign_files_petitions_blog?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240528_we_filed&n=4) including remarks from me and my friend Congressional candidate Jose Vega, who successfully filed over 10,000 signatures last week against a requirement of 3,500 to obtain ballot status in NY-CD 15, the district currently misrepresented by Rep. Ritchie Torres, who, like Sen. Gillibrand has received hundreds of thousands of dollars from AIPAC. If you haven't yet completed the pre-primary legal donation of $3300, please donate today to help launch the break out phase of the campaign ahead! | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/donate?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240528_we_filed&n=5 "DONATE") [DONATE](https://www.sareforsenate.com/donate?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240528_we_filed&n=5)

May I have just a second of your time, please?

Tomorrow, campaigns like mine will be hustling to close fundraising gaps for our end-of-month deadlines.

**This is a big deal for my Senate campaign.**

I’d be the first woman and person of color elected to the Senate from Delaware. Pundits understand that our race is historic and they’ll use our fundraising numbers as a bellwether of our viability. name: David Hogg
subject: Why age matters
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Take a second to think about some of our most successful presidents — so many of them were under 30 when they first got their start in public life.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240530-2&t=1&akid=744%2E587540%2El_z6vX)
Peter,
Since launching Leaders We Deserve, I’ve gotten a lot of questions about why we’re focused on electing young candidates. So today I wanted to take a second to talk about why a candidate’s age actually matters.
Take a second to think about some of our most successful presidents — _so many of them_ were under 30 when they first got their start in public life:
* **President Biden was 29** when he was first elected to public office
* **LBJ was 28** when he started his career
* **FDR was 28** when he was elected to the New York State Senate
* **Thomas Jefferson was 26** when he was first elected in Virginia
* **Abraham Lincoln was 25** when he was elected to the Illinois legislature

**[Pitch in to elect more young leaders →](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240530?amount=5&refcode=em20240530-2-744&refcode2=744_587540_l_z6vX&akid=744%2E587540%2El_z6vX)**
And you know what? That early start helped each of those guys gain a ton of experience that served them throughout their entire career. It’s just common sense, honestly.
Peter, that's a major reason we're getting to work _now_ to get other leaders like them elected at a young age.
Not only will they be able to provide a sorely needed perspective as young people in government, but we’ll also be building a bench of experienced leaders for the future.
**As a grassroots organization that doesn't take corporate donations, we can't do this without your support, Peter!**
**[So if you're ready to help us elect young leaders all over the country this November, pitch in $5 to support our work ahead of our end-of-month fundraising deadline tomorrow:](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240530?refcode=em20240530-2&amount=5&refcode2=744_587540_l_z6vX&akid=744%2E587540%2El_z6vX)**

Thanks again for all your help,
David Hogg

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-america?refcode=email_20220217_SA_endorsements [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-america?refcode=email_20220217_SA_endorsements]Friend,
On Friday of last week, news broke that Vladimir Putin had murdered Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny. That news sent a shockwave throughout the world and prompted world leaders to respond.
Putin is a murderous dictator who loathes dissent, free speech and true democracy. Though his regime killed Navalny, they won’t be able to quash his legacy. His life and his work gave hope and voice to millions of Russians who are tired of Putin -- people who are ready to fight for change.
But since the war in Ukraine started, there has been a rapidly growing faction of the Republican Party that idolizes Putin. In fact, the Russian President appears to have a real grip on what now seems like a significant portion of MAGA Republicans. It’s strange and it’s scary, friend.
That’s why today, in the wake of this news, I’m asking you to make a contribution to Serve America -- an organization dedicated to electing a new generation of Democratic leaders to Congress. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-america] I can assure you, they believe in democracies, side with America, and know better than to idolize Vladimir Putin.
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-america?refcode=email_20220217_SA_endorsements]
In his final message to the world, Navalny reminded us that "the only thing necessary for the triumph of evil, is for good people to do nothing."
This is an election year. Trump, who leads the Republican Party and will likely be on the ballot in November, has openly fawned over Putin. He’s repeatedly shared his admiration of him and many in his party are now following his lead.
We cannot afford to do nothing. We have to fight this year and every year to elect leaders who love America and work to improve our democracy -- not break it.
Navalny had what Putin will never have: courage, true patriotism, soul.
Let’s honor him by continuing to fight.
-Seth

Now Israeli tanks are advancing further into Rafah, all in defiance of the world’s highest court, which ordered an “immediate halt” to military operations in Rafah last week. **Our country is the primary funder and arms supplier for this genocide, and our government’s leaders are continually enabling Israel to act with impunity.** President Biden had previously warned that attacks on Rafah would be a “red line” for him, but spokespeople for his administration have said these latest atrocities haven’t crossed a red line, noting that there will be “no policy changes” to limit support for Israel’s government. **Instead of condemning or acting to stop Israel’s well-documented war crimes, President Biden’s administration and members of Congress are condemning efforts by the world’s top courts and the United Nations to hold Israel accountable.** For example, Secretary of State Antony Blinken recently told GOP Senators that he’d like to work with them on sanctioning the International Criminal Court for seeking arrest warrants against Israel’s leaders. Israel’s government has committed multiple war crimes this week alone, including bombing an ambulance and a field hospital in Rafah, blocking crucial humanitarian aid through Rafah’s border crossing with Egypt, and targeting journalists and aid workers.
**Rather than condemning these horrors or implementing consequences, President Biden’s administration and members of Congress are trying to stop international legal bodies from holding Israel accountable for its human rights violations.**
In response to the chief prosecutor for the International Criminal Court’s (ICC) application for arrest warrants against Israeli leaders for war crimes, President Biden called this move “outrageous” and said: “We will always stand with Israel.”
Republican senators have also threatened the ICC, including Senator Lindsay Graham, who met with Israel’s Prime Minister and President to talk about undermining the ICC. Graham has also said the International Court of Justice (which is pursuing a genocide case) can “go to hell.”
The Guardian and Israeli media outlets just published an investigation about Israeli intelligence agencies pressuring and threatening the ICC’s former top prosecutor for years, trying to get her to drop her investigation into Israel’s human rights abuses in Palestine. Former President Trump participated in this effort, issuing sanctions against her.
The ICC’s current chief prosecutor recently warned that he will act against “attempts to impede, intimidate or improperly influence the officials of this Court.” He said, “such threats, even when not acted upon, may also constitute” a violation of law.

clean_body: Rather than condemning Israel’s war crimes, lawmakers are condemning attempts to hold Israel accountable. | | | Friend, This week, the Israeli military used U.S. bombs to commit massacres at multiple refugee tent camps in Rafah, burning Palestinian children and families alive. Now Israeli tanks are advancing further into Rafah, all in defiance of the world’s highest court, which ordered an “immediate halt” to military operations in Rafah last week. Our country is the primary funder and arms supplier for this genocide, and our government’s leaders are continually enabling Israel to act with impunity. President Biden had previously warned that attacks on Rafah would be a “red line” for him, but spokespeople for his administration have said these latest atrocities haven’t crossed a red line, noting that there will be “no policy changes” to limit support for Israel’s government. Instead of condemning or acting to stop Israel’s well-documented war crimes, President Biden’s administration and members of Congress are condemning efforts by the world’s top courts and the United Nations to hold Israel accountable. For example, Secretary of State Antony Blinken recently told GOP Senators that he’d like to work with them on sanctioning the International Criminal Court for seeking arrest warrants against Israel’s leaders. | Israel’s government has committed multiple war crimes this week alone, including bombing an ambulance and a field hospital in Rafah, blocking crucial humanitarian aid through Rafah’s border crossing with Egypt, and targeting journalists and aid workers. Rather than condemning these horrors or implementing consequences, President Biden’s administration and members of Congress are trying to stop international legal bodies from holding Israel accountable for its human rights violations. In response to the chief prosecutor for the International Criminal Court’s (ICC) application for arrest warrants against Israeli leaders for war crimes, President Biden called this move “outrageous” and said: “We will always stand with Israel.” Republican senators have also threatened the ICC, including Senator Lindsay Graham, who met with Israel’s Prime Minister and President to talk about undermining the ICC. Graham has also said the International Court of Justice (which is pursuing a genocide case) can “go to hell.” The Guardian and Israeli media outlets just published an investigation about Israeli intelligence agencies pressuring and threatening the ICC’s former top prosecutor for years, trying to get her to drop her investigation into Israel’s human rights abuses in Palestine. Former President Trump participated in this effort, issuing sanctions against her. The ICC’s current chief prosecutor recently warned that he will act against “attempts to impede, intimidate or improperly influence the officials of this Court.” He said, “such threats, even when not acted upon, may also constitute” a violation of law. Thank you for continuing to demand a world that values all life, no matter faith or ethnicity. We will not give up in the struggle to save lives. Our economy was stronger. Gas was cheaper. Our neighborhoods were safer. Our border was more secure. The list goes on and on.

Friend--
Earlier today, Donald Trump was found guilty of multiple felonies related to his conduct in the 2016 election. He’s the first president in history to ever face criminal charges, let alone be convicted of any crime.
It is hard to believe, as I write this from beautiful Mackinac Island, that we will find ourselves in a position where the Republican nominee for president is a convicted felon, and that while there are so many things we must work on that have an impact on people's pocketbooks, this is the issue of the moment in the presidential campaign.
I wish for our nation, and especially for the people of Michigan, that this was not the issue before us. But here we are.
Unfortunately, Trump’s guilty verdict will probably fire up his MAGA-base more than ever before. We have already seen his legal issues result in an intense media and fundraising boon for him, and this moment will probably make those moments look small by comparison.
You can expect those resources, and those passions, to be funneled here into Michigan. Because like I've said before, and like we all know, there is no winning the White House without winning Michigan. And because our race is the top of the ticket, the results of our race will weigh heavily on which presidential candidate carries the state.
That will benefit our potential Republican opponent. And it means we have to be ready to face that intensity head-on. So I am asking:

| | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=886a03ed66b44781ad73a150aee45b1d&_e=-4sdLmvESynDubRli8D9n_VG6knbg5KCYLN8nwoBxvSSyDxns8RpEbIM9aLhpUktTBPDaK86ExqqLKEIh_jJCQFY_SDlO6XRkinn87RWZpNxV3EBg3A3LTLDNt5qN_UwnRi0boz4rUKOGYcP9Le_WN3YE0tboXrN7zjkpLF8cPBBS414tU1hAM0MZk9YmWeQzJQLNPu2BMNERD0L_91MQbDYfdcNp6a5g1mnc0BO_jBJQ4WlEQ7RlPe877dVL-TWzPF2G2vLvpun9necfYsHL_JOTlGy28eGBVd4Y0ztz7GMS3-iJGIFCdzr6J9G2y_8XgRk9h9QZ1U_8FxMutuji9AkzTk4ZWjOeyxT22mkMXLm2Z5_e-vQBdYcROEym4JcmCU9s_7eevJrt57YyT2xt40o5wSY0QH8qOvy9_l2AvU%3D)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

It cost my brother and me our military careers after the former-president retaliated against us. Eugene Vindman is running for Virginia’s open 7th Congressional District. Eugene served 25 years in the Army and is ready to fight with Jason Crow to defend our democracy against Donald Trump’s allies. We hope you’ll read his message below, and then split a donation between his and Jason’s campaigns. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85961425/476390054/1707145561?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_EOM_AC30_20240530_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNmI5ZDdmOC1jZjFlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5LiRV-pIcRo5Y50GpU4V52pmGy8y-ou6fP7omavla0E=) Friend — give me just a moment to tell you the story of a phone call that changed everything. I’m Eugene Vindman. My brother Alex and I used to serve on the White House National Security Council. I was the senior ethics official on the Council. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85961426/476390061/1707145561?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_EOM_AC30_20240530_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNmI5ZDdmOC1jZjFlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5LiRV-pIcRo5Y50GpU4V52pmGy8y-ou6fP7omavla0E=) In 2019, Alex overheard a phone call in which President Trump attempted to extort our allies in Ukraine. Trump threatened to withhold military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated his political rival. After Alex reported the call to me, we both blew the whistle on Trump. We reported Trump’s corrupt phone call up the chain of command, and it led to his impeachment. Even though the decision to blow the whistle on Donald Trump was the right thing to do, it cost my brother and me our military careers after the former-president retaliated against us. But I am not done serving. **I’m running for Congress in Virginia to fight back against Trump and the far-right Republicans who enable his abuse of power and attacks on our Democracy.** And more than that, I’m running to push our country forward across the board. To restore abortion rights everywhere, act on climate change, and lower costs for working families. So here’s the deal. If we win Virginia’s 7th district, we win a highly competitive swing district and make it that much more likely that Democrats take back the House. And if we take back the House, we can begin to make progress on those issues while safeguarding against any Republican attempts to roll back our rights. So, with Virginia’s Primary Election Day just around the corner, please: **[Split a contribution between me and Jason Crow to support my campaign for Congress. Trump threatened to withhold military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated his political rival. After Alex reported the call to me, we both blew the whistle on Trump. subject: Your Voice Matters: Get Involved
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the New Pennsylvania Project
body:
View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/08a18370eeb0/we-need-your-help-to-do-big-things-in-13665116?e=95417d7e87)
Logo

Hi Friend Unknown,

Welcome to the latest New Pennsylvania Project newsletter! In this edition, you'll find critical election news, updates on upcoming and recent events, and exciting career opportunities. We’re here to keep you informed about our progress in breaking down voting barriers, key election updates, and the initiatives shaping Pennsylvania's future.

We also address how unfair the proposed Pennsylvania budget is and how it threatens to direct funding away from our communities so the rich can get richer. This budget and the headlines in the news are a reminder of why we must continue our efforts at all levels—on the streets and in the courts—to protect our rights and our communities. Freedom and liberation are projects in progress, not a destination we have reached.

As we gear up for the 2024 general election, we invite you to join us in our mission to educate and mobilize voters who then vote every election to make change in our communities.

Stay informed with essential election resources and dates as we approach the 2024 General Election on November 5th.

Remember, your voice matters, and we’re here to provide the information and resources needed to shape Pennsylvania’s future.

Thank you for staying informed and engaged! Together change is possible.

** NPP in the News
------------------------------------------------------------

📢 Don't miss out tonight at 7:30pm! NPP CEO Kadida Kenner will be on Roland Martin Unfiltered to discuss voting rights and the upcoming election.

Roland Martin is an important truth teller and leading voice in Black journalism. Together they will discuss how we can boost Black voter turnout and protect our rights at the polls. 📺 Tune in on the Black Star Network (https://www.blackstarnetwork.com/) , YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/user/rolandsmartin) , and Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/rolandsmartinfanpage) .

** PA Senate Republicans Should Want the People and Not Their Wealthy Backers to Benefit from the Billion Dollar Budget Surplus
------------------------------------------------------------

Check out the latest op-ed by the New Pennsylvania Project's CEO Kadida Kenner in the Bucks County Beacon (https://www.facebook.com/buckscountybeacon?__cft__[0]=AZVFrcWbCTLbs1FIUnggU0HeE_GTEiJ44UITYlOraEgt9EVzvW_qW45zWVdaGoSpRDKC1UxeXMYQXBT4TRRAqyQtqKQeVfeuONK7aYvHQSfp7ddO6CF7K-FQwGkpTTpDxBu6H0u4u-qRQx2nJ1H-vxQepi6lT15jVQ9xO14jGCL9266vf6mUwEd8989NJr5g_VmuJ7Se41KuLCZte4-ZPlaK&__tn__=-]K-R) ! Kadida discusses the importance of prioritizing communities' real problems and restoring confidence in our government.

She highlights the PA Senate Republicans' failure to use surplus funding for schools and vital services, instead favoring wealthy backers. It's time for leadership that genuinely represents the people of Pennsylvania!

"As the leader of the New Pennsylvania Project, a voting rights organization focused on empowering new voters in ignored communities to engage in the democratic process. Nothing makes that work more challenging than when leaders ignore communities’ real problems and undermine confidence in our government."
Read the full article (https://buckscountybeacon.com/2024/05/pa-senate-republicans-should-want-the-people-and-not-their-wealthy-backers-to-benefit-from-the-billion-dollar-budget-surplus/)

** Voting rights groups file lawsuit to challenge Pennsylvania mail-in ballot date requirement
------------------------------------------------------------

We stands in support of the New PA Project Education Fund (https://www.facebook.com/NPPedfund?__cft__[0]=AZWz_APnlEZkCEL6oooERjQCtsk34CiuN6tFAXP68B1ajN20zEqI8PusIO2cVjphvStF_KCi1Sjwp9aQIheoWvYQmgxPPc5P8SXK1MsSlEjFEMZL-wlhswzNlKEFaW_RYjS2CH4TgDMZpjbo_ka9P97xdZrXOsu2p7hricUeNYIi5NoE0C5TKEd8sGQhJi14-kQ_wgb9cXw9Kn4p3iXysSgk&__tn__=-]K-R) (NPPEF), ACLU of Pennsylvania (https://www.facebook.com/aclupa?__cft__[0]=AZWz_APnlEZkCEL6oooERjQCtsk34CiuN6tFAXP68B1ajN20zEqI8PusIO2cVjphvStF_KCi1Sjwp9aQIheoWvYQmgxPPc5P8SXK1MsSlEjFEMZL-wlhswzNlKEFaW_RYjS2CH4TgDMZpjbo_ka9P97xdZrXOsu2p7hricUeNYIi5NoE0C5TKEd8sGQhJi14-kQ_wgb9cXw9Kn4p3iXysSgk&__tn__=-]K-R) , Public Interest Law Center (https://www.facebook.com/publicinterestlawcenter?__cft__[0]=AZWz_APnlEZkCEL6oooERjQCtsk34CiuN6tFAXP68B1ajN20zEqI8PusIO2cVjphvStF_KCi1Sjwp9aQIheoWvYQmgxPPc5P8SXK1MsSlEjFEMZL-wlhswzNlKEFaW_RYjS2CH4TgDMZpjbo_ka9P97xdZrXOsu2p7hricUeNYIi5NoE0C5TKEd8sGQhJi14-kQ_wgb9cXw9Kn4p3iXysSgk&__tn__=-]K-R) in their lawsuit against the Pennsylvania
Department of State and PA Secretary of State, Al Schmidt.

It is important to fight at all levels to ensure that every voter has their mail-in ballots counted. New voters, Black voters, and new citizens already face so many barriers to participating in our democracy we do not need to make more. We do have a moral and legal responsibility to make sure every eligible voter who casts a ballot is counted.

“Unfortunately, disqualifying voters’ mail ballots over a trivial paperwork error on their return envelope discourages voters from participating in the democratic process,” Kadida Kenner, chief executive officer of the New PA Project Education Fund, said in a statement. “We want Pennsylvanians voting twice a year — every year — not disenfranchised by this unnecessary rule.”

In Pennsylvania, elections are often decided by the slimmest margins, and every vote counts. It's time to protect voter rights and ensure all voices are heard! Change is possible!

The future of our democracy depends on young voters. At the "Stop Trump Summit," NPP CEO Kadida Kenner emphasized the importance of addressing the concerns of voters under 35, who make up 70% of our recent registrations.

Trump blasts his trial judges. Then his fans call for violence.

subject: a very difficult decision.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
One of the many things that separates Ilhan from our opponents in this race is that she knows our movement always has her back when it matters most.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1175%2E791427%2EcLuNEZ)
Hey folks, it's Makenzie. Ilhan's finance director.
I'm reaching out because over the holiday weekend, I made a difficult decision that I felt you deserved to know about.
As we get closer and closer to primary day, it's become clear that in order to continue organizing our progressive coalition in Minnesota's 5th district — and to make sure we have the financial resources to do so — we needed to _significantly_ scale up our organizing and advertising budgets.
Now, as you know, running a campaign isn't cheap. Especially when facing off against billionaires like Harlan Crow and right-wing dark money groups like AIPAC the way Ilhan is.
**Long story short: The money wasn't in our budget for May — but I gave the green light anyway.**
It was a risk. There's no doubt about that. But this is just one of many increasingly difficult decisions we'll have to make in the months ahead if we're going to win.
That's why I made a bet that if I asked, this movement would come together and help us fill the gap. And I'm really hoping you will — today. Not just for me, or for Ilhan, but for everyone across the country who cares about our movement's fight for justice in Congress and beyond.
**[So please: Can you make your first contribution — of $3 or any amount you can — to stand with Ilhan and our campaign today? Every donation ahead of this week's end-of-month deadline will help us catch up while we make critical investments in this campaign.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may24.KcBh3H&refcode=em240530-2-NOR&t=2&akid=1175%2E791427%2EcLuNEZ)**
Like I said, this was a difficult decision, and please know that because of the way we're funding this campaign it wasn't one I made lightly.
But one of the many things that separates Ilhan from our opponents in this race is that she knows our movement always has her back when it matters most.
Thank you for chipping in today if you can.
In solidarity,
Makenzie Richardson
Finance Director

When women ask me about running for office, I tell them about my experience with the Emerge training program. Emerge helped give me the confidence to run and win. = | = After first serving as a federal law enforcement officer and then working undercover as a CIA case officer to keep our country safe, I chose to serve our country in another way: running for Congress. I wanted to use my background and experience to craft sound policy, get things done, and deliver for my community. When I was considering running for public office, Emerge played an important role in my journey. Thanks to Emerge, I was suddenly in a room full of dedicated, determined, and strong women who were considering entering the political arena for the first time. And when I eventually made clear that I was ready to run for Congress, they didn’t hesitate. They said, “Do it.” That’s what sets Emerge apart. You’re surrounded by women who are looking to get involved in their communities. These women are looking to lead — not looking to sit on the sidelines. When I was first elected to Congress in 2018, I was proud to be the first Democrat elected to serve my Virginia district since 1968 — and I was honored to be the first-ever woman to represent my district in the U.S. House of Representatives. Donald Trump has now made history as the first president to ever be convicted of a crime
#

Team - we’re sure that many of you have been keeping up with Donald Trump’s hush money trial. Today, we got our verdict.
**The jury just found our former president GUILTY on all 34 of his felony charges.**
Donald Trump has now made history as the first president to ever be convicted of a crime. Now, Trump is already telling his supporters that the trial was “rigged.”
[**Trump’s MAGA supporters are riled up, and that will no doubt bring a huge surge of support to his campaign. We need your help to fight back. Will you rush in a $3 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC to help us send a strong message that we won’t allow Trump to take back the White House and jeopardize gun safety progress?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-may24.vNbcqy&refcode=em240530-2-30&t=1&akid=8205%2E3935704%2EswVhpr)

We could go on about the long list of reasons that Trump is unfit to serve, and today’s verdict serves as an extreme example.
When it comes to our gun safety movement, Trump has proven that he cares only about cozying up to his buddies in the gun lobby—not keeping the American people safe from preventable gun violence.
During Trump’s presidency, gun homicides spiked by **_34 percent.**_ That is unacceptable.

name: Dave Min for Congress
subject: Min Releases Statement on Trump Verdict
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/cbd619e4d6fe/min-releases-statement-on-trump-verdict-16197408?e=7017cc100e)
---
| |
---
| | **For Immediate Release:** May 30, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Min Releases Statement on Trump Verdict**
**IRVINE, CA** —California State Senator Dave Min, the Democratic Nominee in California’s 47th Congressional District– the most contested House race in the country– issued the following statement concerning the Trump verdict:

**“Today’s unanimous verdict—which came from a jury of 12 of Donald Trump’s peers—was a clear signal that the rule of law still applies in America today, and that no one, no matter how powerful, is above the law. It also means that my Republican opponent Scott Baugh is now officially supporting a convicted felon. That makes perfect sense, because Scott Baugh has spent his career violating the law at every turn. While I started my career prosecuting corporate fraud at the SEC and went on to teach law at UC Irvine, Scott Baugh was hatching criminal schemes such as the campaign finance fraud that resulted in his being indicted for 22 criminal counts—including 4 felonies—or the Orange County GOP’s voter fraud scheme that led to 12 Republican staffers being arrested."**

Min has assembled an impressive coalition of support. In addition to being on the DCCC’s Red to Blue List of priority challengers for the House, Senator Min is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, California Governor Gavin Newsom, and over 50 local elected officials. He is also the consensus choice of Teachers, Police, Firefighters, and Organized Labor, with major endorsements including the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, the Fraternal Order of Police, the Police Officers Research Association of California, the International Association of Firefighters, SEIU, AFSCME, Teamsters, AFL-CIO, and the California Labor Federation. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=01b3fc1290&e=7017cc100e). ###

_California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

Hey there, it’s Dan with the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. 👋
If you’ve been keeping up with our emails, you know we’re gearing up for a big push this election cycle. Why? Because when it comes to combating the fossil fuel industry's grip on our politics, good intentions aren’t enough. We need a solid, actionable plan and financial backing to bring it to life.
We’re building a network of volunteers who are ready to canvass, phone bank, and engage voters in every way possible. We have a few ambitious goals for this undertaking. First, we need to ensure that pro-climate voters in our most important districts know what’s at stake this November when it comes to climate action — and where their candidates’ stances are on advancing climate policy.
And, just as importantly, we need to make sure that people who know these stakes **_actually go out and vote._** I don’t know about you, but it seems like every week there is a new poll or study that comes out explaining how more and more people are starting to become concerned about the future of our climate crisis — and yet, essential climate policies continue to languish year after year.
**This is where a robust field organizing program comes into play.**
While sophisticated media strategies and fancy advertisements play an important role in informing the voting public about candidates, referendums and other ballot measures and persuading people to _support_ a campaign, increasing voter turnout is actually a bit simpler. The more direct one-on-one conversations we can have with voters about the basic mechanics of voting, the more likely it is that they will actually cast their ballot. We will be talking more about this in future emails as time goes on, but for now I have an important ask for you.
As effective as this sort of on-the-ground voter contact is, a robust field program isn’t cheap. From accessing basic voter data to bringing on additional staff capacity to help recruit, train, and manage volunteers, there are some up-front costs that we need to invest in now to make the impact we need come Election Day.
While my role here at the PAC these days includes a diverse portfolio that includes digital communications and organizing volunteers, I have a very special place in my heart for field organizing. Back in 2018, I was on the ground for Beto's campaign in Texas, starting as a field organizer covering the greater Lubbock, TX area and eventually working my way up to GOTV Director. While a few years have gone by, I will always remember fondly how our team managed to mobilize an unprecedented number of volunteers across the state, including hundreds of volunteer leaders who helped manage thousands of other volunteers. I know that may be a weird example to use for this email, since we ultimately lost to... the Junior Senator from Texas who I won’t name here. At the end of the day, while we didn’t win, we were closer than I would have imagined if you were to ask me in 2017.
But that experience taught me the sheer power of grassroots organizing and what can be accomplished when an organization invests in the necessary infrastructure to convert broad grassroots enthusiasm into voter turnout. A strong field program is essential to running a successful campaign, especially when up against the deep pockets of Big Oil. The fossil fuel giants are pouring resources into our elections, thinking they can outspend us to maintain control. What they _aren’t_ accounting for is people like us — passionate, determined, and relentless in our pursuit of a liveable future.
**Here’s where you come in:[A contribution from you today will go a long way in bolstering our field operations. We need to fund essential tools and resources — things like voter outreach software, training materials for volunteers, and multilingual materials.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85963879/476398468/2105508926?refcode=ea.a86d3b14-d71e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.a86d3b14-d71e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImE4NmQzYjE0LWQ3MWUtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=P3OdtRzVTIeLkr0nr5q6vfzRH_sGAO40yHUzWsdaPp4=)**
Every dollar you contribute ensures our volunteers on the ground have what they need to amplify our pro-climate message.
**We're ready to roll up our sleeves and do the hard work, but we can't pull this off without you. Let’s show Big Oil that they might have the money, but we have the people.**

Friends,

Earlier today, Donald Trump was found guilty of multiple felonies related to his conduct in the 2016 election. He’s the first president in history to ever face criminal charges, let alone be convicted of any crime.

It is hard to believe, as I write this from beautiful Mackinac Island, that we will find ourselves in a position where the Republican nominee for president is a convicted felon, and that while there are so many things we must work on that have an impact on peoples' pocketbooks, this is the issue of the moment in the presidential campaign.

I wish for our nation, and especially for the people of Michigan, that this was not the issue before us. But here we are.

Unfortunately, Trump’s guilty verdict will probably fire up his MAGA base more than ever before. We have already seen his legal issues result in an intense media and fundraising boon for him, and this moment will probably make those moments look small by comparison.

You can expect those resources, and those passions, to be funneled here into Michigan. Because like I've said before, and like we all know, there is no winning the White House without winning Michigan. And because our race is the top of the ticket, the results of our race will weigh heavily on which presidential candidate carries the state.

That will benefit our potential Republican opponent. And it means we have to be ready to face that intensity head-on. So I am asking:

clean_body: | = Friends, Earlier today, Donald Trump was found guilty of multiple felonies related to his conduct in the 2016 election. He’s the first president in history to ever face criminal charges, let alone be convicted of any crime. It is hard to believe, as I write this from beautiful Mackinac Island, that we will find ourselves in a position where the Republican nominee for president is a convicted felon, and that while there are so many things we must work on that have an impact on peoples' pocketbooks, this is the issue of the moment in the presidential campaign. I wish for our nation, and especially for the people of Michigan, that this was not the issue before us. But here we are. Unfortunately, Trump’s guilty verdict will probably fire up his MAGA base more than ever before. We have already seen his legal issues result in an intense media and fundraising boon for him, and this moment will probably make those moments look small by comparison. You can expect those resources, and those passions, to be funneled here into Michigan. Because like I've said before, and like we all know, there is no winning the White House without winning Michigan. And because our race is the top of the ticket, the results of our race will weigh heavily on which presidential candidate carries the state. That will benefit our potential Republican opponent. And it means we have to be ready to face that intensity head-on. # The Verdict is in: Trump is Guilty
---
| [ ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/maga-os?refcode=2025)
---
**HUGE news in the presidential election.** Donald Trump has been found guilty on all 34 counts after today's ruling. Former President Trump is now a convicted felon. This guilty verdict is a significant step towards accountability and justice in America, but it is not a time for celebration. We must reflect on how we reached this pivotal moment. **A former president is now a convicted felon,** a fact that will be written into every history book going forward. Today, a jury of our fellow Americans came to the verdict to convict Trump of **deceiving voters and interfering in our elections,** despite facing intimidation and threats. The decision was unanimous, and a critical step toward accountability for the American people. Yet, we still must recognize that we are currently facing a 2024 presidential election where a convicted felon is representing the Republican Party. This moment calls for acknowledgment and action. We need to fight even harder to put MAGA away for good. Ever since January 6th, 2021, we have understood a disturbing fact: **MAGA is willing to stoop to incredible lows in their pursuit of power.** Now the MAGA party is going to be willing to support and vote for Donald Trump, who has been found guilty of 34 felonies, for president. We need to call this out for what it means to MAGA. This will lead to the largest fundraising for Trump that the Republican Party has ever seen. This will motivate the MAGA base to send massive amounts of money to counteract the damage this decision will do to Trump's campaign. **This is why we need to continue to fight against their pursuit for power and send MAGA home FOR GOOD in 2024!** Your support is crucial in this fight for justice and democracy. Together, we can protect our values and our future. [**Join us in this critical battle to protect our nation from MAGA's authoritarian ambitions. Together, we can preserve the very essence of American democracy. Time is of the essence—your immediate action is crucial.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/maga-os?refcode=2025)

Friends,

If you wanted a sign that Democrats are serious about winning back NY-1 from MAGA, get this: 6 out of 8 Democratic Town Committees across New York’s first district have taken the unprecedented step of endorsing John Avlon ahead of the June 25th primary. That’s in addition to the state elected officials and community leaders who know Suffolk County best.

https://twitter.com/TeamAvlonNY/status/1795899263513178295 [https://twitter.com/TeamAvlonNY/status/1795899263513178295]

Want to know what the Huntington Town Democratic Committee, the East Hampton Town Democratic Committee, the Southampton Town Democratic Committee, the Shelter Island Democratic Committee, the Southold Town Democratic Committee, and the Riverhead Democratic Committee all have in common? They are working hard to win this seat back from MAGA this fall, and they know John Avlon is our best chance to win it.

Same with folks like Assembly Member Fred Thiele, Assembly Member Steve Stern, Suffolk County Legislator Rebecca Sanin, Suffolk County Legislator Anne Welker, Former State Senator Jim Gaughran, former Congressman Max Rose, former Suffolk County Legislator Bridget Fleming, and New York State Democratic Chairman Jay S. Jacobs.

Democrats are coming together because we all know we can’t afford to lose this fight. John Avlon is the best candidate to build a broad coalition to take on Nick LaLota this fall – and win.

As Tom Suozzi puts it: “As a life-long Long Islander, I know that John Avlon offers Democrats the best chance in a decade to win New York's First District and help take back the House. Like me, he's a common sense Democrat who understands that we need to play offense on the issues people care about to win swing districts here on Long Island... I know that he's the best choice for Democrats in the upcoming primary because he is the Democrat who can unite the party, seize the vital center and win the general election.”

With less than four weeks to go, your support is critical to helping John bring home victory in this primary and take the fight directly to Nick LaLota. We’re out there talking to voters right now, but we need to make sure we have what it takes to win. Can you pitch in before our final end-of-month deadline and power us to victory? Let’s keep the momentum going!

-Team Avlon

body:
| Earlier today, Donald Trump was found guilty of multiple felonies related to his conduct in the 2016 election. He’s the first president in history to ever face criminal charges, let alone be convicted of any crime.

It is hard to believe, as I write this from beautiful Mackinac Island, that we will find ourselves in a position where the Republican nominee for president is a convicted felon, and that while there are so many things we must work on that have an impact on peoples' pocketbooks, this is the issue of the moment in the presidential campaign.

I wish for our nation, and especially for the people of Michigan, that this was not the issue before us. But here we are.

Unfortunately, Trump’s guilty verdict will probably fire up his MAGA base more than ever before. We have already seen his legal issues result in an intense media and fundraising boon for him, and this moment will probably make those moments look small by comparison.

You can expect those resources, and those passions, to be funneled here into Michigan. Because like I've said before, and like we all know, there is no winning the White House without winning Michigan. And because our race is the top of the ticket, the results of our race will weigh heavily on which presidential candidate carries the state.

That will benefit our potential Republican opponent. And it means we have to be ready to face that intensity head-on. So I am asking:
